38 void
39 ATermToSageJovialTraversal::setLocationSpecifier(SgVariableDeclaration* var_decl, const LocationSpecifier &loc_spec)
40 {
41 // The bitfield will contain both the start_bit and start_word as an expression list
42  SgExprListExp* location_specifier = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp();
43 
44  SgExpression* start_bit = loc_spec.start_bit;
45  SgExpression* start_word = loc_spec.start_word;
46 
47  start_bit ->set_parent(location_specifier);
48  start_word->set_parent(location_specifier);
49 
50  location_specifier->get_expressions().push_back(start_bit);
51  location_specifier->get_expressions().push_back(start_word);
52 
53  var_decl->set_bitfield(location_specifier);
54  location_specifier->set_parent(var_decl);
55 }

82  ATerm module;
83 
84  if (ATmatch(term, "Module(<term>)", &module)) {
85 
86  SgScopeStatement* sage_tree_scope{nullptr};
87  sage_tree_builder.Enter(sage_tree_scope);
88  setSourcePosition(sage_tree_scope, term, false);
89 
90  if (traverse_CompoolModule(module)) {
91  // MATCHED CompoolModule
92  }
93  else if (traverse_ProcedureModule(module)) {
94  // MATCHED ProcedureModule
95  }
96  else if (traverse_MainProgramModule(module)) {
97  // MATCHED MainProgramModule
98  } else return ATfalse;
99 
100  sage_tree_builder.Leave(sage_tree_scope);
101  }
102  else return ATfalse;
103 
104  return ATtrue;

108 // 1.2.1 COMPOOL MODULES
109 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
110 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_CompoolModule(ATerm term)
111 {
112 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
113  printf("... traverse_CompoolModule: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
114 #endif
115 
116  ATerm t_dirs, t_name, t_decls;
117  std::string name;
118  RB::SourcePositionPair sources;
119  std::vector<RB::Token> saved_comments{};
120  SgGlobal* global{nullptr};
121  SgJovialCompoolStatement* compool_stmt{nullptr};
122  SgNamespaceDeclarationStatement* namespace_decl{nullptr};
123 
124  if (ATmatch(term, "CompoolModule(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_dirs, &t_name, &t_decls)) {
125  // Attach comments preceding CompoolModule START
126  global = isSgGlobal(SageBuilder::topScopeStack());
127  sage_tree_builder.attachComments(global, PosInfo{global});
128 
129  // Traverse Name first to have it available
130  if (traverse_Name(t_name, name)) {
131  // MATCHED Name
132  } else return ATfalse;
133 
134  // The directive list should be traversed before the namespace is created in case a compool
135  // directive is found and then the loaded compool module can be placed in global scope
136  // without creating the namespace. Compool directives should go in global scope.
137  if (traverse_DirectiveList(t_dirs)) {
138  // MATCHED DirectiveList
139  } else return ATfalse;
140 
141  sage_tree_builder.Enter(namespace_decl, name, sources);
142  setSourcePosition(namespace_decl, term, false);
143 
144  sage_tree_builder.Enter(compool_stmt, name, sources);
145  sage_tree_builder.Leave(compool_stmt);
146 
147  // Let CompoolModule start with its name (rather than global scope). This
148  // helps with comment placement.
149  setSourcePositionIncludingTerm(compool_stmt, t_name, term);
150  sage_tree_builder.attachComments(compool_stmt);
151 
152  if (traverse_DeclarationList(t_decls)) {
153  // MATCHED DeclarationList and CompoolDeclarationList
154  } else return ATfalse;
155 
156  } else return ATfalse;
157 
158  sage_tree_builder.Leave(namespace_decl);
159 
160  // Attach any remaining comments to the global scope
161  sage_tree_builder.attachRemainingComments(global, PosInfo{global});
162 
163  return ATtrue;
164 }

264 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_MainProgramModule(ATerm term)
265 {
266 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
267  printf("... traverse_MainProgramModule: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
268 #endif
269 
270  ATerm t_decls, t_name, t_body, t_funcs;
271  SgGlobal* global{nullptr};
272  std::vector<RB::Token> comments{};
273  SgProgramHeaderStatement* program_decl{nullptr};
274 
275  if (ATmatch(term, "MainProgramModule(<term>,<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_decls,&t_name,&t_body,&t_funcs)) {
276  std::string name;
277  std::vector<std::string> labels;
278 
279  // Attach comments preceding MainProgramModule START
280  global = isSgGlobal(SageBuilder::topScopeStack());
281  sage_tree_builder.attachComments(global, PosInfo{global});
282 
283  if (traverse_DeclarationList(t_decls)) {
284  // MATCHED DeclarationList
285  } else return ATfalse;
286 
287  if (traverse_Name(t_name, name)) {
288  // MATCHED Name
289  } else return ATfalse;
290 
291  // Note that MainProgramModule term start and end is not that of the function,
292  // the Program name is the best we can do for a starting position.
293  RB::SourcePosition name_start, name_end; // start and end of program name
294  RB::SourcePosition body_start, body_end; // start and end of body
295  setSourcePositions(t_name, name_start, name_end);
296  setSourcePositions(t_body, body_start, body_end);
297  RB::SourcePositions sources(name_start, body_start, body_end);
298 
299  // Enter SageTreeBuilder for SgProgramHeaderStatement
300  sage_tree_builder.Enter(program_decl, boost::optional<std::string>(name), labels, sources, comments);
301 
302  if (traverse_ProgramBody(t_body)) {
303  // MATCHED ProgramBody
304  } else return ATfalse;
305 
306  // Leave SageTreeBuilder for SgProgramHeaderStatement
307  sage_tree_builder.Leave(program_decl);
308 
309  if (traverse_NonNestedSubroutineList(t_funcs)) {
310  // MATCHED NonNestedSubroutineList
311  } else return ATfalse;
312  }
313  else return ATfalse;
314 
315  // Attach any remaining comments to the global scope
316  sage_tree_builder.attachRemainingComments(global, PosInfo{global});
317 
318  return ATtrue;
319 }

335 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_ProgramBody(ATerm term)
336 {
337 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
338  printf("... traverse_ProgramBody: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
339 #endif
340  ATerm t_stmt, t_stmts, t_funcs, t_labels;
341 
342  if (ATmatch(term, "ProgramSimpleBody(<term>)", &t_stmt)) {
343  if (traverse_Statement(t_stmt)) {
344  // MATCHED Statement
345  } else return ATfalse;
346  }
347  else if (ATmatch(term, "ProgramBody(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_stmts,&t_funcs,&t_labels)) {
348  std::vector<std::string> labels;
349  std::vector<PosInfo> locations;
350 
351  if (traverse_DeclsAndStmts(t_stmts)) {
352  // MATCHED DeclarationList
353  } else return ATfalse;
354 
355  if (traverse_SubroutineDefinitionList(t_funcs)) {
356  // MATCHED SubroutineDefinitionList
357  } else return ATfalse;
358 
359  if (traverse_LabelList(t_labels, labels, locations)) {
360  // MATCHED LabelList
361  } else return ATfalse;
362 
363  if (labels.size() > 1) {
364  mlog[WARN] << "UNIMPLEMENTED: ProgramBody - labels.size > 1\n";
365  return ATtrue;
366  }
367  }
368  else return ATfalse;
369 
370  return ATtrue;
371 }

373 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_NonNestedSubroutineList(ATerm term)
374 {
375 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
376  printf("... traverse_NonNestedSubroutineList: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
377 #endif
378 
379  ATerm t_subroutine_list, t_proc;
380  LanguageTranslation::FunctionModifierList function_modifiers;
381 
382  if (ATmatch(term, "NonNestedSubroutineList(<term>)", &t_subroutine_list)) {
383 
384  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_subroutine_list);
385  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
386  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
387  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
388 
389  // Reuse the modifier list
390  function_modifiers.clear();
391 
392  if (ATmatch(head, "NonNestedSubroutine(<term>)", &t_proc)) {
393  // MATCHED NonNestedSubroutine
394  }
395  else if (ATmatch(head, "NonNestedSubroutineDEF(<term>)", &t_proc)) {
396  function_modifiers.push_back(LanguageTranslation::e_function_modifier_definition);
397  }
398  else return ATfalse;
399 
400  if (traverse_ProcedureDefinition(t_proc, function_modifiers)) {
401  // MATCHED ProcedureDefinition
402  }
403  else if (traverse_FunctionDefinition(t_proc, function_modifiers)) {
404  // MATCHED FunctionDefinition
405  }
406  else return ATfalse;
407 
408  }
409  }
410  else return ATfalse;
411 
412  return ATtrue;
413 }

415 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_SubroutineDefinitionList(ATerm term)
416 {
417 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
418  printf("... traverse_SubroutineDefinitionList: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
419 #endif
420 
421  LanguageTranslation::FunctionModifierList function_modifiers;
422 
423  if (ATmatch(term, "[]")) {
424  // Matched an empty list
425  return ATtrue;
426  }
427 
428 // At this point there must be a non-empty list to succeed
429 //
430  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", term);
431  if (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
432  // found a non-empty list
433  } else return ATfalse;
434 
435  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
436  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
437  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
438  if (traverse_ProcedureDefinition(head, function_modifiers)) {
439  // MATCHED ProcedureDefinition
440  } else if (traverse_FunctionDefinition(head, function_modifiers)) {
441  // MATCHED FunctionDefinition
442  } else return ATfalse;
443  }
444 
445  return ATtrue;
446 }

451 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_IntegerMachineParameter(ATerm term, SgExpression* &expr)
452 {

462  auto scope = SageBuilder::getGlobalScopeFromScopeStack();
463 
464  // BITSINBYTE, BITSINWORD, BITSINPOINTER, BYTEPOS, BYTESINWORD
465  //
466  if (ATmatch(term, "BITSINBYTE")) {
467  expr = SageBuilder::buildVarRefExp("BITSINBYTE", scope);

469  else if (ATmatch(term, "BITSINWORD")) {
470  expr = SageBuilder::buildVarRefExp("BITSINWORD", scope);

473  expr = SageBuilder::buildVarRefExp("BITSINPOINTER", scope);
474  }
475  else if (ATmatch(term, "BYTEPOS(<term>)", &t_formula)) {
476  SgExpression* pp{nullptr};

478  // MATCHED CompileTimeNumericFormula
479  } else return ATfalse;
480  auto params = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp_nfi();
481  params->append_expression(pp);
482  expr = buildIntrinsicFunctionCallExp_nfi(std::string{"BYTEPOS"}, params, scope);

499  else if (ATmatch(term, "FLOATRELPRECISION(<term>)", &t_formula)) {

628  else if (ATmatch(term, "IMPLFLOATPRECISION(<term>)", &t_precision)) {
629  mlog[WARN] << "UNIMPLEMENTED: IntegerMachineParameter - IMPLFLOATPRECISION\n";
630  // MATCHED IMPLFLOATPRECISION
631  if (traverse_Formula(t_precision, expr)) {
632  // MATCHED Precision
633  } else return ATfalse;
634  }
635  else if (ATmatch(term, "IMPLFIXEDPRECISION(<term>,<term>)", &t_scale_spec, &t_frac_spec)) {
636  mlog[WARN] << "UNIMPLEMENTED: IntegerMachineParameter - IMPLFIXEDPRECISION\n";
637  // MATCHED IMPLFIXEDPRECISION
638  if (traverse_Formula(t_scale_spec, expr)) {
639  // MATCHED ScaleSpecifier
640  } else return ATfalse;
641  if (traverse_Formula(t_frac_spec, expr)) {
642  // MATCHED FractionSpecifier
643  } else return ATfalse;
644  }
645 
646  //TODO:
647  // 'MAXFLOAT' '(' Precision ')' -> FloatingMachineParameter {cons("MAXFLOAT")}
648  // 'MINFLOAT' '(' Precision ')' -> FloatingMachineParameter {cons("MINFLOAT")}
649  // 'MAXFIXED' '(' ScaleSpecifier',' FractionSpecifier ')'-> FixedMachineParameter {cons("MAXFIXED")}
650  // 'MINFIXED' '(' ScaleSpecifier ','FractionSpecifier ')'-> FixedMachineParameter {cons("MINFIXED")}
651 
652  else return ATfalse;
653 
654  ASSERT_not_null(expr);
655  setSourcePosition(expr, term);
656 
657  return ATtrue;
658 }

704  // MATCHED DataDeclaration

706  else if (traverse_ConstantDeclaration(term)) {
707  // MATCHED ConstantDeclaration
708  }

710  // MATCHED TypeDeclaration
711  }
712  else if (traverse_DefineDeclaration(term)) {
713  // MATCHED DefineDeclaration
714  }
715  else if (traverse_OverlayDeclaration(term)) {
716  // MATCHED OverlayDeclaration
717  }
718  else if (traverse_StatementNameDeclaration(term)) {
719  // MATCHED StatementNameDeclaration
720  }
721  else if (traverse_InlineDeclaration(term)) {
722  // MATCHED InlineDeclaration
723  }

725  // MATCHED NullDeclaration
726  }
727  else if (traverse_Directive(term)) {
728  // MATCHED Directive
729  }
730  else return ATfalse;

732  return ATtrue;

762 //========================================================================================
763 // 2.1.1 ITEM DECLARATION
764 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
765 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_ItemDeclaration(ATerm term, int def_or_ref)
766 {
767 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
768  printf("... traverse_ItemDeclaration: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
769 #endif
770 
771  ATerm t_name, t_alloc, t_type, t_preset;
772  char* name;
773 
774  SgType* declared_type = nullptr;
775  SgExpression* preset = nullptr;
776  Sawyer::Optional<SgExpression*> status_size;
777  Sawyer::Optional<LanguageTranslation::ExpressionKind> modifier_enum;
778  SgEnumDeclaration* enum_decl = nullptr;
779  bool is_anonymous = false;
780 
781  std::string label = "";
782 
783  if (ATmatch(term, "ItemDeclaration(<term>,<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_name,&t_alloc,&t_type,&t_preset)) {
784  if (ATmatch(t_name, "<str>", &name)) {
785  // MATCHED ItemName
786  } else return ATfalse;
787 
788  if (traverse_OptAllocationSpecifier(t_alloc, modifier_enum)) {
789  // MATCHED OptAllocationSpecifier
790  } else return ATfalse;
791 
792  if (match_StatusItemDescription(t_type)) {
793  // Build EnumDecl so that StatusItemDescription traversal has it to use
794  is_anonymous = true;
795  std::string anon_type_name = mangleAnonymousName(name);
796 
797  // Begin SageTreeBuilder
798  sage_tree_builder.Enter(enum_decl, anon_type_name);
799  setSourcePosition(enum_decl, term);
800  }
801 
802  if (traverse_ItemTypeDescription(t_type, declared_type)) {
803  // MATCHED ItemTypeDescription without StatusItemDescription
804  }
805  else if (traverse_StatusItemDescription(t_type, enum_decl, status_size)) {
806  // MATCHED StatusItemDescription: Note that they are handled differently
807  // than other ItemTypeDescriptions because they require different arguments
808 
809  if (status_size) {
810  SgType* field_type = SageBuilder::buildIntType(*status_size);
811  enum_decl->set_field_type(field_type);
812  }
813 
814  // End SageTreeBuilder
815  sage_tree_builder.Leave(enum_decl);
816 
817  ASSERT_not_null(enum_decl);
818  declared_type = isSgEnumType(enum_decl->get_type());
819  ASSERT_not_null(declared_type);
820  }
821  else return ATfalse;
822 
823  // ItemPreset is optional
824  if (traverse_ItemPreset(t_preset, preset)) {
825  // MATCHED ItemPreset
826  } else return ATfalse;
827  }
828  else return ATfalse;
829 
830  if (declared_type == nullptr) {
831  mlog[WARN] << "ERROR: ItemDeclaration - variable type is null\n";
832  ASSERT_not_null(declared_type);
833  }
834 
835 // Begin SageTreeBuilder
836  SgVariableDeclaration* var_decl{nullptr};
837  sage_tree_builder.Enter(var_decl, std::string(name), declared_type, preset, std::vector<std::string>{}/*labels*/);
838  setSourcePosition(var_decl, term);
839 
840 // Begin language specific constructs
841  setDeclarationModifier(var_decl, def_or_ref);
842 
843  if (modifier_enum && *modifier_enum == e_storage_modifier_static) {
844  // Set static on both modifier attributes, JovialStatic is used for unparsing
845  var_decl->get_declarationModifier().setJovialStatic();
846  var_decl->get_declarationModifier().get_storageModifier().setStatic();
847  }
848 
849 // Jovial block and table members are visible in parent scope so create an alias
850 // to the symbol if needed.
851  sage_tree_builder.injectAliasSymbol(std::string(name));
852 
853  if (is_anonymous) {
854  SgEnumType* enum_type = isSgEnumType(declared_type);
855  ASSERT_not_null(enum_type);
856  SgEnumDeclaration* decl = isSgEnumDeclaration(enum_type->get_declaration());
857  ASSERT_not_null(decl);
858  SgEnumDeclaration* def_decl = isSgEnumDeclaration(decl->get_definingDeclaration());
859  ASSERT_not_null(def_decl);
860  sage_tree_builder.setBaseTypeDefiningDeclaration(var_decl, def_decl);
861  }
862 
863 // End SageTreeBuilder
864  sage_tree_builder.Leave(var_decl);
865 
866  return ATtrue;
867 }
868 
869 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_ItemTypeDescription(ATerm term, SgType* &type)
870 {
871 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
872  printf("... traverse_ItemTypeDescription: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
873 #endif
874 
875  std::string name;
876  type = nullptr;
877 
878 // StatusItemDescription is handled separately because it requires different arguments
879  if (match_StatusItemDescription(term)) {
880  return ATfalse;
881  }
882 
883  if (traverse_IntegerItemDescription(term, type)) {
884  // MATCHED IntegerItemDescription
885  }
886  else if (traverse_FloatingItemDescription(term, type)) {
887  // MATCHED FloatingItemDescription
888  }
889  else if (traverse_FixedItemDescription(term, type)) {
890  // MATCHED FixedItemDescription
891  }
892  else if (traverse_BitItemDescription(term, type)) {
893  // MATCHED BitItemDescription
894  }
895  else if (traverse_CharacterItemDescription(term, type)) {
896  // MATCHED CharacterItemDescription
897  }
898  else if (traverse_PointerItemDescription(term, type)) {
899  // MATCHED PointerItemDescription
900  }
901  else if (traverse_Name(term, name)) {
902  // MATCHED ItemTypeName
903  SgSymbol* symbol = SI::lookupSymbolInParentScopes(name, SB::topScopeStack());
904 
905  if (symbol == nullptr) {
906  mlog[WARN] << "ERROR: ItemTypeDescription - symbol lookup failed for ItemTypeName " << name << "\n";
907  }
908  ASSERT_not_null(symbol);
909  type = symbol->get_type();
910  ASSERT_not_null(type);
911  }
912  else return ATfalse;
913 
914  ASSERT_not_null(type);
915 
916  return ATtrue;
917 }

919 //========================================================================================
920 // 2.1.1.1 INTEGER TYPE DESCRIPTIONS
921 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
922 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_IntegerItemDescription(ATerm term, SgType* &type)
923 {
924 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
925  printf("... traverse_IntegerItemDescription: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
926 #endif
927 
928  ATerm t_type, t_round_or_truncate, t_size;
929  bool is_signed;
930 
931  Sawyer::Optional<LanguageTranslation::ExpressionKind> modifier_enum;
932  Sawyer::Optional<SgExpression*> opt_size;
933  SgExpression* kind = nullptr;
934 
935 // The first term, t_type, comes from the lexer and is direct user input: "S", "s", "U", "u".
936 // We disambiguate it via terms IntegerItemDescription or IntegerItemDescriptionU.
937  if (ATmatch(term, "IntegerItemDescription(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_type,&t_round_or_truncate,&t_size)) {
938  is_signed = true;
939  }
940  else if (ATmatch(term, "IntegerItemDescriptionU(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_type,&t_round_or_truncate,&t_size)) {
941  is_signed = false;
942  }
943  else return ATfalse;
944 
945  if (traverse_OptRoundOrTruncate(t_round_or_truncate, modifier_enum)) {
946  // MATCHED OptRoundOrTruncate
947  } else return ATfalse;
948 
949  if (traverse_OptItemSize(t_size, opt_size)) {
950  // MATCHED OptItemSize
951  } else return ATfalse;
952 
953  if (opt_size) kind = *opt_size;
954 
955  if (is_signed) {
956  type = SageBuilder::buildIntType(kind);
957  } else {
958  type = SageBuilder::buildUnsignedIntType(kind);
959  }
960  ASSERT_not_null(type);
961 
962  if (modifier_enum) {
963  SgModifierType* mod_type = SageBuilder::buildModifierType(type);
964 
965  if (*modifier_enum == LanguageTranslation::e_type_modifier_round) {
966  mod_type->get_typeModifier().setRound();
967  }
968  else if (*modifier_enum == LanguageTranslation::e_type_modifier_truncate) {
969  mod_type->get_typeModifier().setTruncate();
970  }
971  else if (*modifier_enum == LanguageTranslation::e_type_modifier_z) {
972  mod_type->get_typeModifier().setTruncateTowardsZero();
973  }
974  else ROSE_ABORT();
975 
976  type = mod_type;
977  }
978  ASSERT_not_null(type);
979 
980  return ATtrue;
981 }
982 
983 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_OptItemSize(ATerm term, Sawyer::Optional<SgExpression*> &size)
984 {
985 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
986  printf("... traverse_OptItemSize: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
987 #endif
988  ATerm t_size;
989  SgExpression* size_expr{nullptr};
990 
991  if (ATmatch(term, "no-item-size()")) {
992  size = Sawyer::Nothing();
993  }
994  else if (ATmatch(term, "ItemSize(<term>)", &t_size)) {
995  if (traverse_Formula(t_size, size_expr)) {
996  ASSERT_not_null(size_expr);
997  size = Sawyer::Optional<SgExpression*>(size_expr);
998  } else return ATfalse;
999  }
1000  else return ATfalse;
1001 
1002  return ATtrue;
1003 }

1008 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_FloatingItemDescription(ATerm term, SgType* &type)
1009 {

1013 
1014  ATerm t_floating_type_desc, t_round_or_truncate, t_precision;

1019  // MATCHED FloatingItemDescription
1020  }
1021  else return ATfalse;
1022 
1023  // The first term, t_floating_type_desc, comes from the lexer and is direct user input: "F", "f".
1024 
1025  // rounding or truncate mode
1026  if (traverse_OptRoundOrTruncate(t_round_or_truncate, modifier_enum)) {
1027  // MATCHED OptRoundOrTruncate
1028  }
1029  else return ATfalse;
1030 
1031  // precision
1032  if (ATmatch(t_precision, "no-precision()")) {
1033  // MATCHED no-precision
1034  }
1035  else if (traverse_Formula(t_precision, precision)) {
1036  // MATCHED Formula
1037  }
1038  else return ATfalse;
1039 
1040  type = SageBuilder::buildFloatType(precision);
1041 
1042  if (modifier_enum) {
1043  SgModifierType* mod_type = SageBuilder::buildModifierType(type);
1044 
1045  if (*modifier_enum == LanguageTranslation::e_type_modifier_round) {
1046  mod_type->get_typeModifier().setRound();
1047  }
1048  else if (*modifier_enum == LanguageTranslation::e_type_modifier_truncate) {
1049  mod_type->get_typeModifier().setTruncate();
1050  }
1051  else if (*modifier_enum == LanguageTranslation::e_type_modifier_z) {
1052  mod_type->get_typeModifier().setTruncateTowardsZero();
1053  }
1054  else ROSE_ABORT();
1055 
1056  type = mod_type;
1057  }
1058  ASSERT_not_null(type);
1059 
1060  return ATtrue;
1061 }

1063 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_OptRoundOrTruncate(ATerm term, Sawyer::Optional<LanguageTranslation::ExpressionKind> &modifier_enum)
1064 {
1065 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
1066  printf("... traverse_OptRoundOrTruncate: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
1067 #endif
1068 
1069  if (ATmatch(term, "no-round-or-truncate()")) {
1070  modifier_enum = Sawyer::Nothing();
1071  }
1072  else if (ATmatch(term, "R()")) {
1073  modifier_enum = Sawyer::Optional<LanguageTranslation::ExpressionKind>(e_type_modifier_round);
1074  }
1075  else if (ATmatch(term, "T()")) {
1076  modifier_enum = Sawyer::Optional<LanguageTranslation::ExpressionKind>(e_type_modifier_truncate);
1077  }
1078  else if (ATmatch(term, "Z()")) {
1079  modifier_enum = Sawyer::Optional<LanguageTranslation::ExpressionKind>(e_type_modifier_z);
1080  }
1081  else return ATfalse;
1082 
1083  return ATtrue;
1084 }

1100  // MATCHED FixedItemDescription
1101  }
1102  else return ATfalse;

1105

1107  // MATCHED OptRoundOrTruncate
1108  } else return ATfalse;
1109 
1110  if (ATmatch(t_scale, "ScaleSpecifier(<term>)", &t_scale_spec)) {
1111  if (traverse_Formula(t_scale_spec, scale)) {

1113  } else return ATfalse;
1114  } else return ATfalse;

1116  if (ATmatch(t_fraction, "no-fraction-specifier()")) {
1117  // MATCHED no-fraction-specifier
1118  }
1119  else if (ATmatch(t_fraction, "OptFractionSpecifier(<term>)", &t_frac_spec)) {
1120  if (traverse_FractionSpecifier(t_frac_spec, fraction)) {
1121  } else return ATfalse;
1122  }
1123  else return ATfalse;

1125  type = SageBuilder::buildFixedType(scale, fraction);

1129 
1130  if (*modifier_enum == LanguageTranslation::e_type_modifier_round) {

1134  mod_type->get_typeModifier().setTruncate();
1135  }
1136  else if (*modifier_enum == LanguageTranslation::e_type_modifier_z) {
1137  mod_type->get_typeModifier().setTruncateTowardsZero();
1138  }
1139  else ROSE_ABORT();
1140 
1141  type = mod_type;
1142  }
1143  ASSERT_not_null(type);

1145  return ATtrue;

1250 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1251 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_StatusConstant(ATerm term, SgEnumDeclaration* enum_decl, int value, SgCastExp* cast)
1252 {
1253 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
1254  printf("... traverse_StatusConstant: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
1255 #endif
1256 
1257 // NOTE: Name -> StatusConstant , Letter -> StatusConstant, ReservedWord -> StatusConstant
1258  char* name;
1259 
1260  if (ATmatch(term, "StatusConstant(<str>)", &name)) {
1261  std::string enum_name{mangleStatusConstantName(name)};
1262 
1263  // Begin SageTreeBuilder
1264  SgEnumVal* enum_val = nullptr;
1265  sage_tree_builder.Enter(enum_val, enum_name, enum_decl, value, cast);
1266 
1267  // There is either an SgEnumVal or an SgCastExp
1268  if (enum_val) {
1269  setSourcePosition(enum_val, term);
1270  }
1271 
1272  // End SageTreeBuilder
1273  sage_tree_builder.Leave(enum_val);
1274  }
1275  else return ATfalse;
1276 
1277  return ATtrue;
1278 }
1279 
1280 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_StatusConstant(ATerm term, SgExpression* &expr)
1281 {
1282 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
1283  printf("... traverse_StatusConstant: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
1284 #endif
1285 
1286 // NOTE: Name -> StatusConstant , Letter -> StatusConstant, ReservedWord -> StatusConstant
1287  char* name;
1288 
1289  expr = nullptr;
1290 
1291  if (ATmatch(term, "StatusConstant(<str>)", &name)) {
1292  std::string constant_name{mangleStatusConstantName(name)};
1293 
1294  // An enumerator in Jovial is scoped! Therefore we have to worry about finding the correct one.
1295  // I think we don't have to worry about it here, perhaps only when using pointers?
1296 
1297  // Would be nice to have a lookupEnumFieldSymbol in SageInterface
1298  SgSymbol* symbol = SI::lookupSymbolInParentScopes(constant_name, SB::topScopeStack());
1299  SgEnumFieldSymbol* enum_field_symbol = isSgEnumFieldSymbol(symbol);
1300  ASSERT_not_null(enum_field_symbol);
1301 
1302  SgInitializedName* init_name = enum_field_symbol->get_declaration();
1303  SgAssignInitializer* initializer = isSgAssignInitializer(init_name->get_initializer());
1304 
1305  expr = isSgEnumVal(initializer->get_operand());
1306  if (expr == nullptr) {
1307  // Could be a cast (see regression test gitlab-issue-261.jov)
1308  expr = isSgCastExp(initializer->get_operand());
1309  }
1310  }
1311  else return ATfalse;
1312 
1313  ASSERT_not_null(expr);
1314  setSourcePosition(expr, term);
1315 
1316  return ATtrue;
1317 }

1365 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_DefaultSublist(ATerm term, SgEnumDeclaration* enum_decl)

1372  int value = 0;
1373 
1374  if (ATmatch(term, "DefaultSublist(<term>)", &t_sublist)) {
1375  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_sublist);
1376  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
1377  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
1378  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
1379 
1380  if (traverse_StatusConstant(head, enum_decl, value)) {
1381  // MATCHED StatusConstant
1382  } else return ATfalse;
1383 
1384  ++value;
1385  }
1386  } else return ATfalse;

1388  return ATtrue;

1399  if (ATmatch(term, "no-default-sublist()")) {
1400  // MATCHED no default sublist

1412 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_StatusList(ATerm term, SgEnumDeclaration* enum_decl)
1413 {
1414 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
1415  printf("... traverse_StatusList: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
1416 #endif
1417 
1418  ATerm t_sublist, t_specified;
1419 
1420  // 1. default initializer used for first portion of list
1421  // 2. one specified initializer is used as start for rest of sublist
1422  //
1423  // WARNING: do not create multiple lists !!!
1424 
1425  if (ATmatch(term, "StatusList(<term>,<term>)", &t_sublist, &t_specified)) {
1426  if (traverse_OptDefaultSublist(t_sublist, enum_decl)) {
1427  // MATCHED OptDefaultSublist
1428  } else return ATfalse;
1429 
1430  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_specified);
1431  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
1432  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
1433  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
1434  if (traverse_SpecifiedSublist(head, enum_decl)) {
1435  // MATCHED SpecifiedSublist
1436  } else return ATfalse;
1437  }
1438  } else return ATfalse;
1439 
1440  return ATtrue;
1441 }
1442 
1443 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_SpecifiedSublist(ATerm term, SgEnumDeclaration* enum_decl)
1444 {
1445 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
1446  printf("... traverse_SpecifiedSublist: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
1447 #endif
1448 
1449  ATerm t_formula, t_constant;
1450  SgCastExp* cast{nullptr};
1451  SgExpression* init_expr{nullptr};
1452 
1453  if (ATmatch(term, "SpecifiedSublist(<term>,<term>)", &t_formula, &t_constant)) {
1454 
1455  if (traverse_Formula(t_formula, init_expr)) {
1456  // MATCHED Formula
1457  } else return ATfalse;
1458  ASSERT_not_null(init_expr);
1459 
1460  int pass = 1;
1461  int value;
1462 
1463  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_constant);
1464  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
1465  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
1466  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
1467 
1468  if (pass == 1) {
1469  if (auto intval = isSgIntVal(init_expr)) {
1470  value = intval->get_value();
1471  // The initialization expression for the enum is no longer needed
1472  delete init_expr; init_expr = nullptr;
1473  }
1474  else {
1475  cast = isSgCastExp(init_expr);
1476  }
1477  }
1478  if (pass > 1) {
1479  ++value;
1480  }
1481 
1482  if (traverse_StatusConstant(head, enum_decl, value, cast)) {
1483  ++pass;
1484  }
1485  else return ATfalse;
1486  }
1487  }
1488  else return ATfalse;
1489 
1490  return ATtrue;
1491 }

1544 //========================================================================================
1545 // 2.1.2 TABLE DECLARATION
1546 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1547 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_TableDeclaration(ATerm term, int def_or_ref, bool constant)
1548 {
1549 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
1550  printf("\n... traverse_[Constant]TableDeclaration: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
1551 #endif
1552 
1553  ATerm t_name, t_alloc, t_dim_list, t_table_desc;
1554  char* name;
1555 
1556 // A TableDeclaration is a variable declaration. However, it may also (usually) define a type
1557 // as well, in which case the type will be anonymous, unless only a table type name if given.
1558 
1559 // Begin SageTreeBuilder
1560  SgJovialTableStatement* table_decl = nullptr;
1561  SgJovialTableType* table_type = nullptr;
1562  SgType* base_type = nullptr;
1563  SgType* type = nullptr;
1564  SgExprListExp* attr_list = nullptr;
1565  SgExprListExp* dim_info = nullptr;
1566  SgExpression* preset = nullptr;
1567  bool table_needs_body = false;
1568  std::string table_var_name, table_type_name, anon_type_name;
1569 
1570  TableSpecifier table_spec;
1571  Sawyer::Optional<LanguageTranslation::ExpressionKind> modifier_enum;
1572 
1573 // ConstantTableDeclaration is shared with TableDeclaration for reuse
1574  if (constant) {
1575  if (ATmatch(term, "ConstantTableDeclaration(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_name,&t_dim_list,&t_table_desc)) {
1576  // MATCHED ConstantTableDeclaration
1577  } else return ATfalse;
1578  }
1579  else {
1580  if (ATmatch(term, "TableDeclaration(<term>,<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_name,&t_alloc,&t_dim_list,&t_table_desc)) {
1581  // MATCHED TableDeclaration
1582  } else return ATfalse;
1583  }
1584 
1585  std::string label = "";
1586 
1587  dim_info = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp();
1588 
1589  if (ATmatch(t_name, "<str>", &name)) {
1590  // MATCHED TableName
1591  } else return ATfalse;
1592 
1593  table_var_name = std::string(name);
1594  anon_type_name = mangleAnonymousName(table_var_name);
1595 
1596  if (!constant) {
1597  if (traverse_OptAllocationSpecifier(t_alloc, modifier_enum)) {
1598  // MATCHED OptAllocationSpecifier
1599  } else return ATfalse;
1600  }
1601 
1602  if (traverse_OptDimensionList(t_dim_list, dim_info)) {
1603  // MATCHED OptDimensionList
1604  } else return ATfalse;
1605 
1606 // 1. Look for a type name first (there will exist a TYPE declaration for the base type)
1607 // The type name is the name of the base type.
1608 //
1609  if (traverse_TableDescriptionName(t_table_desc, table_type_name, base_type, preset)) {
1610  if (dim_info->get_expressions().size() == 0) {
1611  table_type = isSgJovialTableType(base_type);
1612  ASSERT_not_null(table_type);
1613  // Make sure there isn't a dangling pointer
1614  delete dim_info;
1615  dim_info = nullptr;
1616  }
1617  else {
1618  table_type = SB::buildJovialTableType(table_type_name, base_type, dim_info, SB::topScopeStack());
1619  }
1620  type = table_type;
1621  }
1622 
1623 // 2. Otherwise look for a primitive base type (similar to the base type of an array type).
1624 // The base type is the table description and there will be no body.
1625 //
1626  else if (traverse_TableDescriptionType(t_table_desc, base_type, preset, attr_list, table_spec)) {
1627  // Check to see if this is a pointer type with SgTypeUnknown as base_type (and use its name, see gitlab-issue-395.jov)
1628  // Reset pointer base-type name so the base type can be replaced when it has been declared
1629  if (SgPointerType* pointer = isSgPointerType(base_type)) {
1630  if (SgJovialTableType* tableType = isSgJovialTableType(pointer->get_base_type())) {
1631  table_type_name = tableType->get_name();
1632  }
1633  else if (SgTypeUnknown* unknown = isSgTypeUnknown(pointer->get_base_type())) {
1634  table_type_name = unknown->get_type_name();
1635  }
1636  }
1637  table_type = SB::buildJovialTableType(table_type_name, base_type, dim_info, SB::topScopeStack());
1638  type = table_type;
1639  }
1640 
1641 // 3. Finally check for a table description body. This will need to create a table declaration
1642 // with a body for the table definition member variables. The declaration will be anonymous
1643 // and associated with the variable declaration (via baseTypeDefiningDeclaration).
1644 //
1645 // This is the first pass to create the table type from which a variable declaration
1646 // can be declared. A second pass will be required to insert the body of the table.
1647 // The body can't be read before the variable is created because a table item may
1648 // reference the table name (in particular, UBOUND(table_name,0)).
1649 //
1650  else if (traverse_TableDescriptionBody(t_table_desc, anon_type_name, table_decl)) {
1651  ASSERT_not_null(table_decl);
1652  setSourcePosition(table_decl, term);
1653 
1654  table_needs_body = true;
1655 
1656  table_type = isSgJovialTableType(table_decl->get_type());
1657  ASSERT_not_null(table_type);
1658 
1659  if (dim_info) {
1660  table_type->set_dim_info(dim_info);
1661  dim_info->set_parent(table_type);
1662  }
1663  type = table_type;
1664  }
1665  else return ATfalse;
1666 
1667  ASSERT_not_null(type);
1668  ASSERT_not_null(table_type);
1669 
1670  if (constant) {
1671  // Create const SgModifierType with declared_type as base_type
1672  type = SageBuilder::buildConstType(type);
1673  }
1674 
1675 // Begin SageTreeBuilder
1676  SgVariableDeclaration* var_decl = nullptr;
1677 
1678  sage_tree_builder.Enter(var_decl, table_var_name, type, preset, std::vector<std::string>{}/*labels*/);
1679  setSourcePosition(var_decl, term);
1680 
1681 // Begin language specific constructs
1682  setDeclarationModifier(var_decl, def_or_ref);
1683 
1684  SgJovialTableStatement* decl = isSgJovialTableStatement(table_type->get_declaration());
1685  ASSERT_not_null(decl);
1686  SgJovialTableStatement* def_decl = isSgJovialTableStatement(decl->get_definingDeclaration());
1687  ASSERT_not_null(def_decl);
1688  if (dim_info) {
1689  sage_tree_builder.setBaseTypeDefiningDeclaration(var_decl, def_decl);
1690  }
1691 
1692  SgClassDefinition* def = def_decl->get_definition();
1693  ASSERT_not_null(def);
1694  ROSE_ASSERT(def->isCaseInsensitive());
1695 
1696 // Jovial block and table members are visible in parent scope so create an alias
1697 // to the symbol if needed.
1698  sage_tree_builder.injectAliasSymbol(table_var_name);
1699 
1700  if (anon_type_name.size() > 0) {
1701  // The table type should have a symbol also
1702  sage_tree_builder.injectAliasTypeSymbol(anon_type_name);
1703  }
1704 
1705  sage_tree_builder.Leave(var_decl);
1706 
1707 // Traverse the table description a second time (if required) to insert the table members
1708 // from the table body. See description in comment #3 above as to why this is required.
1709  if (table_needs_body) {
1710  // There should not be a preset because it is read with the table body
1711  ASSERT_require(preset == nullptr);
1712  ASSERT_not_null(table_decl);
1713  ASSERT_not_null(var_decl);
1714 
1715  // Insert the table members and get the preset
1716  ASSERT_require( traverse_TableDescriptionBody(t_table_desc, table_decl, preset, table_spec) );
1717 
1718  // If there is a preset, an initializer must be set now because it wasn't possible when
1719  // the variable was declared.
1720  if (preset) {
1721  SgAssignInitializer* init_expr = SB::buildAssignInitializer_nfi(preset, type);
1722  SgInitializedName* init_name = var_decl->get_decl_item(table_var_name);
1723  ASSERT_not_null(init_name);
1724 
1725  init_name->set_initializer(init_expr);
1726  init_expr->set_parent(init_name);
1727  setSourcePositionFrom(init_expr, preset);
1728  }
1729  }
1730 
1731 // Begin language specific constructs
1732  setDeclarationModifier(var_decl, def_or_ref);
1733 
1734  if (modifier_enum && *modifier_enum == e_storage_modifier_static) {
1735  // Set static on both modifier attributes, JovialStatic is used for unparsing
1736  var_decl->get_declarationModifier().setJovialStatic();
1737  var_decl->get_declarationModifier().get_storageModifier().setStatic();
1738  }
1739 
1740 // Set the structure specifier if present
1741  const StructureSpecifier& struct_spec = table_spec.struct_spec;
1742  if (struct_spec.is_parallel) {
1743  table_type->set_structure_specifier(StrucSpecEnum::e_parallel);
1744  }
1745  else if (struct_spec.is_tight) {
1746  table_type->set_structure_specifier(StrucSpecEnum::e_tight);
1747  table_type->set_bits_per_entry(struct_spec.bits_per_entry);
1748  }
1749 
1750  if (table_spec.packing_spec != e_packing_spec_unknown) {
1751  SgStorageModifier& storage_mod = var_decl->get_declarationModifier().get_storageModifier();
1752  if (table_spec.packing_spec == e_packing_spec_none) storage_mod.setPackingNone();
1753  else if (table_spec.packing_spec == e_packing_spec_mixed) storage_mod.setPackingMixed();
1754  else if (table_spec.packing_spec == e_packing_spec_dense) storage_mod.setPackingDense();
1755  }
1756 
1757 // TODO: DELETE_ME - StructureSpecifier information has been placed in SgJovialTableType
1758 // If this works out, this code should be removed and the node deleted in ROSETTA
1759 #if 0
1760  // Wrap the type in an SgStructureModifier if needed
1761  if (struct_spec.is_parallel || struct_spec.is_tight) {
1762  SgModifierType* modifiers = SageBuilder::buildModifierType(type);
1763  if (struct_spec.is_parallel) {
1764  modifiers->get_typeModifier().get_structureModifier().setParallel();
1765  }
1766  else if (struct_spec.is_tight) {
1767  modifiers->get_typeModifier().get_structureModifier().setTight();
1768  modifiers->get_typeModifier().get_structureModifier().set_bits_per_entry(struct_spec.bits_per_entry);
1769  }
1770 
1771  // Reset the type to the SgModifierType wrapper
1772  type = modifiers;
1773  }
1774 #endif
1775 
1776  return ATtrue;
1777 }
1778 
1779 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::
1780 traverse_TableDescriptionName(ATerm term, std::string &type_name, SgType* &type, SgExpression* &preset)
1781 {
1782 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
1783  printf("... traverse_TableDescriptionName: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
1784 #endif
1785 
1786  ATerm t_name, t_preset;
1787 
1788  type = nullptr;
1789  preset = nullptr;
1790 
1791  if (ATmatch(term, "TableDescriptionName(<term>,<term>)", &t_name, &t_preset)) {
1792  if (traverse_Name(t_name, type_name)) {
1793  // MATCHED Name
1794  } else return ATfalse;
1795 
1796  // The name should be useful
1797  ROSE_ASSERT(type_name.length() > 0);
1798 
1799  // This type should have already been created by a type declaration statement
1800  SgSymbol* symbol = SI::lookupSymbolInParentScopes(type_name, SB::topScopeStack());
1801  if (symbol != nullptr) {
1802  type = symbol->get_type();
1803  }
1804  if (type == nullptr) {
1805  mlog[WARN] << "ERROR: TableDescriptionName - class symbol is null for type name " << type_name << "\n";
1806  }
1807 
1808  if (traverse_TablePreset(t_preset, preset)) {
1809  // MATCHED TablePreset
1810  } else return ATfalse;
1811 
1812  }
1813  else return ATfalse;
1814 
1815  if (type == nullptr) {
1816  mlog[WARN] << "ERROR: TableDescriptionName - type == nullptr\n";
1817  ASSERT_not_null(type);
1818  }
1819 
1820  return ATtrue;
1821 }
1822 
1823 // This table is array-like in that it doesn't have a table/structure body (but has a base type)
1824 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::
1825 traverse_TableDescriptionType(ATerm term, SgType* &type, SgExpression* &preset,
1826  SgExprListExp* attr_list, TableSpecifier &table_spec)
1827 {
1828 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
1829  printf("... traverse_TableDescriptionType: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
1830 #endif
1831 
1832  ATerm t_struct_spec, t_entry_spec;
1833  std::string type_name;
1834 
1835 // TODO
1836  LocationSpecifier location_spec;
1837 
1838  StructureSpecifier& struct_spec = table_spec.struct_spec;
1839 
1840  if (ATmatch(term, "TableDescription(<term>,<term>)", &t_struct_spec, &t_entry_spec)) {

1842  // This is an EntrySpecifier without a body

1846 
1847  if (traverse_OptStructureSpecifier(t_struct_spec, struct_spec)) {
1848  // MATCHED OptStructureSpecifier

1850  }
1851  else return ATfalse;

1855  return ATtrue;

1968  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {

1981 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_Dimension(ATerm term, SgExprListExp* shape)
1982 {
1983 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
1984  printf("... traverse_Dimension: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
1985 #endif
1986 
1987  ATerm t_opt_lower_bound, t_lower_bound, t_upper_bound;
1988 
1989  SgExpression* lower_bound = nullptr;
1990  SgExpression* upper_bound = nullptr;
1991  SgExpression* stride = nullptr;
1992 
1993  SgSubscriptExpression* range = nullptr;
1994 
1995  if (ATmatch(term, "Dimension(<term>,<term>)", &t_opt_lower_bound, &t_upper_bound)) {
1996 
1997  // Lower bound (optional)
1998  if (ATmatch(t_opt_lower_bound, "no-lower-bound-option()")) {
1999  // lower bound has already been initialized to nullptr
2000  }
2001  else if (ATmatch(t_opt_lower_bound, "LowerBoundOption(<term>)", &t_lower_bound)) {
2002  // Lower bound can be either a (CompileTime) Formula or a StatusFormula
2003  if (traverse_Formula(t_lower_bound, lower_bound)) {
2004  // MATCHED Formula
2005  }
2006  else if (traverse_StatusFormula(t_lower_bound, lower_bound)) {
2007  // MATCHED StatusFormula
2008  }
2009  else return ATfalse;
2010  }
2011  else return ATfalse;
2012 
2013  // Upper bound can be either a (CompileTime) Formula or a StatusFormula
2014  if (traverse_Formula(t_upper_bound, upper_bound)) {
2015  // MATCHED Formula
2016  }
2017  else if (traverse_StatusFormula(t_upper_bound, upper_bound)) {
2018  // MATCHED StatusFormula
2019  }
2020  else return ATfalse;
2021  }
2022  else if (ATmatch(term, "DimensionSTAR()")) {
2023  lower_bound = SageBuilder::buildNullExpression_nfi();
2024  upper_bound = new SgAsteriskShapeExp();
2025  setSourcePosition(upper_bound, term);
2026  }
2027  else return ATfalse;
2028 
2029 // Begin SageTreeBuilder
2030  if (stride == nullptr) {
2031  // ROSE (Fortran) uses "1" rather than SgNullExpression
2032  stride = SageBuilder::buildIntVal_nfi(std::string("1"));
2033  }
2034 
2035  range = SageBuilder::buildSubscriptExpression_nfi(lower_bound, upper_bound, stride);
2036  range->set_parent(shape);
2037  shape->get_expressions().push_back(range);
2038 
2039  return ATtrue;
2040 }

2045 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_OptStructureSpecifier(ATerm term, StructureSpecifier &struct_spec)
2046 {
2047 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
2048  printf("... traverse_OptStructureSpecifier: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
2049 #endif
2050 
2051  ATerm t_tight, t_bits_per_entry;
2052  SgExpression* bits_per_entry = nullptr;
2053 
2054 // Default
2055  struct_spec.is_tight = false;
2056  struct_spec.is_parallel = false;
2057  struct_spec.bits_per_entry = 0;
2058 
2059  if (ATmatch(term, "no-structure-specifier()")) {
2060  // MATCHED no-structure-specifier
2061  }
2062  else if (ATmatch(term, "StructureSpecifier()")) {
2063  // PARALLEL option
2064  struct_spec.is_parallel = true;
2065  }
2066  else if (ATmatch(term, "StructureSpecifierT(<term>, <term>)", &t_tight, &t_bits_per_entry)) {
2067  // TIGHT option (t_tight term will always be "P")
2068  struct_spec.is_tight = true;
2069  if (ATmatch(t_bits_per_entry, "no-bits-per-entry()")) {
2070  // MATCHED StructureSpecifier with no-bits-per-entry
2071  }
2072  else if (traverse_Formula(t_bits_per_entry, bits_per_entry)) {
2073  SgIntVal* int_val = isSgIntVal(bits_per_entry);
2074  ASSERT_not_null(int_val);
2075  ASSERT_require(int_val->get_value() > 0);
2076  struct_spec.bits_per_entry = int_val->get_value();
2077  // the expression/formula for the bits_per_entry is no longer needed as the value is stored
2078  delete bits_per_entry; bits_per_entry = nullptr;
2079  }
2080  else return ATfalse;
2081  }
2082  else return ATfalse;
2083 
2084  return ATtrue;
2085 }

2217  std::string label = "";

2220 
2221  if (ATmatch(t_name, "<str>", &name)) {
2222  // MATCHED TableItemName

2225  if (match_StatusItemDescription(t_item_desc)) {

2230  is_anonymous = true;

2232 
2233  // Begin SageTreeBuilder for enum

2237

2241  else if (traverse_StatusItemDescription(t_item_desc, enum_decl, status_size)) {

2250  // End SageTreeBuilder for enum

2255  ASSERT_not_null(declared_type);

2257  else return ATfalse;

2263  } else return ATfalse;

2274 // Jovial block and table members are visible in parent scope so create an alias

2287

2432 
2433  // process location-specifier here (don't really need to call a function)
2434  if (ATmatch(t_loc_spec, "LocationSpecifier(<term>,<term>)", &t_start_bit, &t_start_word)) {
2435 
2436  if (ATmatch(t_start_bit, "StartingBitSTAR()")) {
2437  start_bit = new SgAsteriskShapeExp();
2438  ASSERT_not_null(start_bit);
2439  setSourcePosition(start_bit, t_start_bit);
2440  }
2441  else if (traverse_Formula(t_start_bit, start_bit)) {
2442  // MATCHED StartingBit
2443  } else return ATfalse;
2444 
2445  if (traverse_Formula(t_start_word, start_word)) {
2446  // MATCHED StartingWord
2447  } else return ATfalse;
2448 
2449  loc_spec = LocationSpecifier(start_bit, start_word);
2450  }
2451 
2452  } else return ATfalse;
2453 
2454  return ATtrue;
2455 }
2456 
2457 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_SpecifiedTableBody(ATerm term)
2458 {
2459 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
2460  printf("... traverse_SpecifiedTableBody: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
2461 #endif
2462  ATerm t_table_option_list;
2463 
2464  if (ATmatch(term, "SpecifiedTableBody(<term>)", &t_table_option_list)) {
2465  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_table_option_list);
2466  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
2467  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
2468  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
2469  if (traverse_SpecifiedTableItemDeclaration(head)) {
2470  // MATCHED SpecifiedTableItemDeclaration
2471  }
2472  else if (traverse_NullDeclaration(head)) {
2473  // MATCHED NullDeclaration
2474  } else return ATfalse;
2475  }
2476  }
2477  else if (traverse_SpecifiedTableItemDeclaration(term)) {
2478  // MATCHED SpecifiedTableItemDeclaration
2479  }
2480  else return ATfalse;
2481 
2482  return ATtrue;
2483 }
2484 
2485 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_SpecifiedTableItemDeclaration(ATerm term)
2486 {
2487 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
2488  printf("... traverse_SpecifiedTableItemDeclaration: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
2489 #endif
2490 
2491  ATerm t_name, t_item_desc, t_preset, t_item_desc2, t_loc_spec, t_start_bit, t_start_word;
2492  char* name;
2493 
2494  SgExpression *preset{nullptr}, *start_bit{nullptr}, *start_word{nullptr};
2495  SgType* item_type = nullptr;
2496  SgExprListExp* attr_list = nullptr;
2497  LocationSpecifier loc_spec(nullptr,nullptr);
2498  SgEnumDeclaration* enum_decl = nullptr;
2499  SgVariableDeclaration* var_decl = nullptr;
2500  bool is_anon = false;
2501 
2502  if (ATmatch(term, "SpecifiedTableItemDeclaration(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_name, &t_item_desc, &t_preset)) {
2503  if (ATmatch(t_name, "<str>", &name)) {
2504  // MATCHED TableItemName
2505  } else return ATfalse;
2506 
2507  attr_list = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp();
2508  setSourcePosition(attr_list, t_item_desc);
2509 
2510  if (ATmatch(t_item_desc, "SpecifiedItemDescription(<term>,<term>)", &t_item_desc2, &t_loc_spec)) {
2511 
2512  // 1. Look for a StatusItemDescription first
2513  if (match_StatusItemDescription(t_item_desc2)) {
2514  Sawyer::Optional<SgExpression*> status_size;
2515 
2516  // This is an anonymous status type because not ItemTypeDescription so will have body
2517  std::string enum_anon_name = mangleAnonymousName(name);
2518  is_anon = true;
2519  enum_decl = nullptr;
2520 
2521  // Begin SageTreeBuilder
2522  sage_tree_builder.Enter(enum_decl, enum_anon_name);
2523  setSourcePosition(enum_decl, term);
2524  if (traverse_StatusItemDescription(t_item_desc2, enum_decl, status_size)) {
2525  if (status_size) {
2526  SgTypeInt* field_type = SageBuilder::buildIntType(*status_size);
2527  enum_decl->set_field_type(field_type);
2528  }
2529 
2530  // End SageTreeBuilder
2531  sage_tree_builder.Leave(enum_decl);
2532 
2533  item_type = enum_decl->get_type();
2534  }
2535  else {
2536  mlog[ERROR] << "matched an StatusItemDescription but failed in building an SgEnumDeclaration \n";
2537  ROSE_ABORT();
2538  }
2539  }
2540 
2541  // 2. This will be a named or intrinsic type
2542  else if (traverse_ItemTypeDescription(t_item_desc2, item_type)) {
2543  // MATCHED ItemTypeDescription without StatusItemDescription
2544  }
2545  else return ATfalse;
2546 
2547  // process location-specifier here (don't really need to call a function)
2548  if (ATmatch(t_loc_spec, "LocationSpecifier(<term>,<term>)", &t_start_bit, &t_start_word)) {
2549 
2550  if (ATmatch(t_start_bit, "StartingBitSTAR()")) {
2551  start_bit = new SgAsteriskShapeExp();
2552  ASSERT_not_null(start_bit);
2553  setSourcePosition(start_bit, t_start_bit);
2554  }
2555  else if (traverse_Formula(t_start_bit, start_bit)) {
2556  // MATCHED StartingBit
2557  } else return ATfalse;
2558 
2559  if (traverse_Formula(t_start_word, start_word)) {
2560  // MATCHED StartingWord
2561  } else return ATfalse;
2562 
2563  loc_spec = LocationSpecifier(start_bit, start_word);
2564  }
2565 
2566  } else return ATfalse;
2567 
2568  if (traverse_TablePreset(t_preset, preset)) {
2569  // MATCHED TablePreset
2570  } else return ATfalse;
2571 
2572  } else return ATfalse;
2573 
2574  ASSERT_not_null(attr_list);
2575 
2576  if (item_type == nullptr) {
2577  mlog[WARN] << "UNIMPLEMENTED: SpecifiedTableItemDeclaration - declared type is null\n";
2578  return ATtrue;
2579  }
2580 
2581 // Begin SageTreeBuilder
2582  sage_tree_builder.Enter(var_decl, std::string(name), item_type, preset, std::vector<std::string>{}/*labels*/);
2583  setSourcePosition(var_decl, term);
2584 
2585 // The bitfield is used to contain both the start_bit and start_word as an expression list
2586  setLocationSpecifier(var_decl, loc_spec);
2587 
2588  if (is_anon) {
2589  SgEnumDeclaration* def_decl = isSgEnumDeclaration(enum_decl->get_definingDeclaration());
2590  ASSERT_not_null(def_decl);
2591  sage_tree_builder.setBaseTypeDefiningDeclaration(var_decl, def_decl);
2592  }
2593 
2594 // Jovial block and table members are visible in parent scope so create an alias
2595 // to the symbol if needed.
2596  sage_tree_builder.injectAliasSymbol(std::string(name));
2597 
2598 // End SageTreeBuilder
2599  sage_tree_builder.Leave(var_decl);
2600 
2601  return ATtrue;
2602 }
2603 
2604 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_WordsPerEntry(ATerm term, Sawyer::Optional<SgExpression*> &entry_size, WordsPerEntry &wpe)
2605 {
2606 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
2607  printf("... traverse_WordsPerEntry: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
2608 #endif
2609 
2610  ATerm t_size;
2611 
2612  SgExpression* table_entry_size = nullptr;
2613  entry_size = Sawyer::Nothing();
2614  wpe = WordsPerEntry::e_default;
2615 
2616  if (ATmatch(term, "WordsPerEntryW(<term>)", &t_size)) {
2617  wpe = WordsPerEntry::e_fixed_length;
2618  if (ATmatch(t_size, "no-entry-size()")) {
2619  // MATCHED no-entry-size
2620  }
2621  else if (traverse_Formula(t_size, table_entry_size)) {
2622  ASSERT_not_null(table_entry_size);
2623  entry_size = Sawyer::Optional<SgExpression*>(table_entry_size);
2624  }
2625  else return ATfalse;
2626  }
2627  else if (ATmatch(term, "WordsPerEntryV()")) {
2628  wpe = WordsPerEntry::e_variable_length;
2629  }
2630  else return ATfalse;
2631 
2632  return ATtrue;
2633 }

2635 //========================================================================================
2636 // 2.1.3 CONSTANT DECLARATIONS
2637 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2638 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_ConstantDeclaration(ATerm term, int defOrRef)
2639 {
2640 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
2641  printf("... traverse_ConstantDeclaration: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
2642 #endif
2643 
2644  ATerm t_name, t_type, t_preset, t_dim_list, t_table_desc;
2645  char* name;
2646 
2647  bool isAnon{false};
2648  std::string label{};
2649 
2650  SgType* declaredType{nullptr};
2651  SgType* constType{nullptr};
2652  SgExpression* preset{nullptr};
2653  SgEnumDeclaration* enumDecl{nullptr};
2654  Sawyer::Optional<SgExpression*> statusSize;
2655 
2656  if (ATmatch(term, "ConstantTableDeclaration(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_name,&t_dim_list,&t_table_desc)) {
2657  // Almost everything in ConstantTableDeclaration is shared with TableDeclaration so reuse it
2658  if (traverse_TableDeclaration(term, defOrRef, /*constant*/true)) {
2659  // MATCHED ConstantTableDeclaration
2660  }
2661  else return ATfalse;
2662 
2663  // The rest (variable declaration part) has been completed by traverse_TableDeclaration
2664  return ATtrue;
2665  }
2666 
2667  else if (ATmatch(term, "ConstantItemDeclaration(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_name, &t_type, &t_preset)) {
2668  if (ATmatch(t_name, "<str>", &name)) {
2669  // MATCHED ItemName
2670  } else return ATfalse;
2671 
2672  if (match_StatusItemDescription(t_type)) {
2673  // Build EnumDecl so that StatusItemDescription traversal has it to use
2674  isAnon = true;
2675  std::string anonTypeName = mangleAnonymousName(name);
2676 
2677  // Begin SageTreeBuilder for enum
2678  sage_tree_builder.Enter(enumDecl, anonTypeName);
2679  setSourcePosition(enumDecl, t_type);
2680  }
2681 
2682  if (traverse_ItemTypeDescription(t_type, declaredType)) {
2683  // MATCHED ItemTypeDescription without StatusItemDescription
2684 
2685  // Create const SgModifierType with declared_type as base_type
2686  constType = SageBuilder::buildConstType(declaredType);
2687  }
2688  else if (traverse_StatusItemDescription(t_type, enumDecl, statusSize)) {
2689  // MATCHED StatusItemDescription: Note that they are handled differently
2690  // than other ItemTypeDescriptions because they require different arguments
2691 
2692  if (statusSize) {
2693  SgType* fieldType{SageBuilder::buildIntType(*statusSize)};
2694  enumDecl->set_field_type(fieldType);
2695  }
2696 
2697  // End SageTreeBuilder
2698  sage_tree_builder.Leave(enumDecl);
2699 
2700  // Create const SgModifierType with declared_type as base_type
2701  declaredType = isSgEnumType(enumDecl->get_type());
2702  constType = SageBuilder::buildConstType(declaredType);
2703  }
2704  else return ATfalse;
2705 
2706  if (traverse_ItemPreset(t_preset, preset)) {
2707  // MATCHED ItemPreset
2708  } else return ATfalse;
2709  }
2710  else return ATfalse;
2711 
2712  if (constType == nullptr) {
2713  mlog[ERROR] << "UNIMPLEMENTED: ConstantDeclaration - type is null";
2714  ROSE_ABORT();
2715  }
2716 
2717  // Begin SageTreeBuilder for variable declaration
2718  SgVariableDeclaration* varDecl{nullptr};
2719  sage_tree_builder.Enter(varDecl, std::string(name), constType, preset, std::vector<std::string>{}/*labels*/);
2720  setSourcePosition(varDecl, term);
2721 
2722  if (preset) {
2723  // Set source position of initializer before var_decl for comment handling
2724  ASSERT_not_null(varDecl->get_decl_item(name));
2725  SgInitializer* initializer = varDecl->get_decl_item(name)->get_initializer();
2726  ASSERT_not_null(initializer);
2727  setSourcePosition(initializer, t_preset);
2728  }
2729 
2730  // Jovial block and table members are visible in parent scope so create an alias
2731  // to the symbol if needed.
2732  sage_tree_builder.injectAliasSymbol(std::string(name));
2733 
2734  if (isAnon) {
2735  SgEnumType* enumType = isSgEnumType(declaredType);
2736  ASSERT_not_null(enumType);
2737  SgEnumDeclaration* decl = isSgEnumDeclaration(enumType->get_declaration());
2738  ASSERT_not_null(decl);
2739  SgEnumDeclaration* defDecl = isSgEnumDeclaration(decl->get_definingDeclaration());
2740  ASSERT_not_null(defDecl);
2741  sage_tree_builder.setBaseTypeDefiningDeclaration(varDecl, defDecl);
2742  }
2743 
2744  // End SageTreeBuilder for variable declaration
2745  sage_tree_builder.Leave(varDecl);
2746 
2747  return ATtrue;
2748 }
2749 
2750 //========================================================================================
2751 // 2.1.4 BLOCK DECLARATION
2752 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2753 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_BlockDeclaration(ATerm term, int def_or_ref)
2754 {
2755 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
2756  printf("... traverse_BlockDeclaration: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
2757 #endif
2758 
2759  ATerm t_name, t_alloc, t_body, t_type_name, t_preset;
2760  std::string block_name, block_type_name;
2761  bool is_anon = false;
2762 
2763  // Begin SageTreeBuilder
2764  Sawyer::Optional<LanguageTranslation::ExpressionKind> modifier_enum;
2765  SgJovialTableStatement* block_decl = nullptr;
2766  SgExpression* preset = nullptr;
2767  SgType* type = nullptr;
2768  std::string type_name;
2769 
2770  if (ATmatch(term, "BlockDeclarationBodyPart(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_name, &t_alloc, &t_body)) {
2771  is_anon = true;
2772 
2773  if (traverse_Name(t_name, block_name)) {
2774  // MATCHED BlockName
2775  } else return ATfalse;
2776 
2777  block_type_name = mangleAnonymousName(block_name);
2778  type_name = block_type_name;
2779 
2780  // Begin SageTreeBuilder for type declaration
2781  RB::SourcePositionPair sources;
2782  sage_tree_builder.Enter(block_decl, type_name, sources, /*is_block*/ true);
2783  setSourcePosition(block_decl, term);
2784 
2785  if (traverse_OptAllocationSpecifier(t_alloc, modifier_enum)) {
2786  // MATCHED OptAllocationSpecifier
2787  } else return ATfalse;
2788 
2789  if (traverse_BlockBodyPart(t_body, block_decl)) {
2790  // MATCHED BlockBodyPart
2791  } else return ATfalse;
2792 
2793  // End SageTreeBuilder for type declaration
2794  type = isSgJovialTableType(block_decl->get_type());
2795  sage_tree_builder.Leave(block_decl);
2796  }
2797 
2798  else if (ATmatch(term, "BlockDeclarationTypeName(<term>,<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_name, &t_alloc, &t_type_name, &t_preset)) {
2799 
2800  if (traverse_Name(t_name, block_name)) {
2801  // MATCHED BlockName
2802  } else return ATfalse;
2803 
2804  if (traverse_Name(t_type_name, block_type_name)) {
2805  // MATCHED BlockTypeName
2806  } else return ATfalse;
2807 
2808  ROSE_ASSERT(block_type_name.length() > 0);
2809 
2810  // This type should have already been created by a type declaration statement
2811  SgClassSymbol* class_symbol = SI::lookupClassSymbolInParentScopes(block_type_name, SB::topScopeStack());
2812  if (class_symbol != nullptr) {
2813  type = class_symbol->get_type();
2814  }
2815  ASSERT_not_null(type);
2816 
2817  if (traverse_OptAllocationSpecifier(t_alloc, modifier_enum)) {
2818  // MATCHED OptAllocationSpecifier
2819  } else return ATfalse;
2820 
2821  if (traverse_BlockPreset(t_preset, preset)) {
2822  // MATCHED BlockPreset
2823  } else return ATfalse;
2824  }
2825  else return ATfalse;
2826 
2827  // Begin SageTreeBuilder for variable declaration
2828  SgVariableDeclaration* var_decl = nullptr;
2829  sage_tree_builder.Enter(var_decl, std::string(block_name), type, preset, std::vector<std::string>{}/*labels*/);
2830  setSourcePosition(var_decl, term);
2831 
2832  // Begin language specific constructs
2833  setDeclarationModifier(var_decl, def_or_ref);
2834 
2835  if (modifier_enum && *modifier_enum == e_storage_modifier_static) {
2836  // Set static on both modifier attributes, JovialStatic is used for unparsing
2837  var_decl->get_declarationModifier().setJovialStatic();
2838  var_decl->get_declarationModifier().get_storageModifier().setStatic();
2839  }
2840 
2841  if (is_anon) {
2842  SgJovialTableStatement* def_decl = isSgJovialTableStatement(block_decl->get_definingDeclaration());
2843  ASSERT_not_null(def_decl);
2844  sage_tree_builder.setBaseTypeDefiningDeclaration(var_decl, def_decl);
2845  }
2846 
2847 // Jovial block and table members are visible in parent scope so create an alias
2848 // to the symbol if needed.
2849  sage_tree_builder.injectAliasSymbol(std::string(block_name));
2850 
2851  // End SageTreeBuilder for variable declaration
2852  sage_tree_builder.Leave(var_decl);
2853 
2854  return ATtrue;
2855 }
2856 
2857 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_BlockBodyPart(ATerm term, SgJovialTableStatement* /*blockDecl*/)
2858 {
2859 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
2860  printf("... traverse_BlockBodyPart: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
2861 #endif
2862 
2863  ATerm t_dirs, t_body_options;
2864 
2865  if (ATmatch(term, "BlockBodyPart(<term>,<term>)", &t_dirs, &t_body_options)) {
2866  if (traverse_DirectiveList(t_dirs)) {
2867  // MATCHED OrderDirective*
2868  } else return ATfalse;
2869 
2870  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_body_options);
2871  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
2872  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
2873  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
2874  if (traverse_DataDeclaration(head)) {
2875  // MATCHED DataDeclaration
2876  }
2877  else if (traverse_OverlayDeclaration(head)) {
2878  // MATCHED OverlayDeclaration
2879  }
2880  else if (traverse_NullDeclaration(head)) {
2881  // MATCHED NullDeclaration
2882  } else return ATfalse;
2883  }
2884  }
2885  else if (traverse_NullDeclaration(term)) {
2886  // MATCHED NullDeclaration
2887  }
2888  else if (traverse_DataDeclaration(term)) {
2889  // MATCHED DataDeclaration
2890  }
2891  else return ATfalse;
2892 
2893  return ATtrue;
2894 }

2896 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_BlockPreset(ATerm term, SgExpression* &preset)
2897 {
2898 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
2899  printf("... traverse_BlockPreset: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
2900 #endif
2901 
2902  ATerm t_preset_list;
2903 
2904  preset = nullptr;
2905 
2906  if (ATmatch(term, "no-block-preset")) {
2907  // MATCHED no-block-preset
2908  }
2909  else if (ATmatch(term, "BlockPreset(<term>)", &t_preset_list)) {
2910 
2911  SgExprListExp* preset_list = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp_nfi();
2912  SgJovialTablePresetExp* block_preset = new SgJovialTablePresetExp(preset_list);
2913  ASSERT_not_null(block_preset);
2914  setSourcePosition(block_preset, term);
2915 
2916  preset = block_preset;
2917 
2918  if (traverse_BlockPresetList(t_preset_list, block_preset)) {

2927 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_BlockPresetList(ATerm term, SgJovialTablePresetExp* block_preset)
2928 {
2929 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
2930  printf("... traverse_BlockPresetList: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
2931 #endif
2932 
2933  ATerm t_preset_value_list, t_table_preset_list;
2934 
2935  ASSERT_not_null(block_preset);
2936  SgExprListExp* preset_list = block_preset->get_preset_list();
2937 
2938  if (ATmatch(term, "BlockPresetList(<term>)", &t_preset_value_list)) {
2939  SgExpression* preset_value = nullptr;
2940 
2941  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_preset_value_list);
2942  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
2943  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
2944  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
2945 
2946  // Check for parentheses
2947  if (ATmatch(head, "BlockPresetValueParens(<term>)", &t_table_preset_list)) {
2948  block_preset->set_need_paren(true);
2949  if (traverse_TablePresetList(t_table_preset_list, block_preset)) {
2950  // MATCHED a TablePresetList for block preset values
2951  }
2952  else {
2953  // There is likely something like "(TablePresetList), (BlockPresetList)"
2954  // This may require modifying grammar or multiple lists.
2955  mlog[WARN] << "UNIMPLEMENTED: BlockPresetList with ( BlockPresetList )\n";
2956  return ATfalse;
2957  }
2958  }
2959  else if (traverse_TablePresetValue(head, preset_value)) {
2960  // MATCHED PresetValue
2961  ASSERT_not_null(preset_value);
2962  preset_list->get_expressions().push_back(preset_value);
2963  preset_value->set_parent(preset_list);
2964  }
2965  else return ATfalse;
2966  }
2967  }
2968  else return ATfalse;
2969 
2970  return ATtrue;
2971 }

2989  else return ATfalse;
2990

3021 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_OptItemPresetValue(ATerm term, SgExpression* &preset)
3022 {

3044  preset = nullptr;

3099 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_TablePresetList(ATerm term, SgJovialTablePresetExp* table_preset)
3100 {
3101 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
3102  printf("... traverse_TablePresetList: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
3103 #endif
3104 
3105  ATerm t_preset_value_list;
3106 
3107  ASSERT_not_null(table_preset);
3108  SgExprListExp* preset_list = table_preset->get_preset_list();
3109 
3110  if (ATmatch(term, "TablePresetList(<term>)", &t_preset_value_list)) {
3111  SgExpression* preset_value = nullptr;
3112 
3113  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_preset_value_list);
3114  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {

3116  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
3117  if (traverse_TablePresetValue(head, preset_value)) {
3118  // MATCHED PresetValue
3119  ASSERT_not_null(preset_value);
3120  preset_list->get_expressions().push_back(preset_value);
3121  preset_value->set_parent(preset_list);
3122  } else return ATfalse;
3123  }
3124  }
3125  else return ATfalse;
3126 
3127  // Wait to set the source position until the entire preset list has been processed
3128  setSourcePosition(table_preset, term, /*attach_comments*/true);

3133 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_PresetIndexSpecifier(ATerm term, SgExprListExp* index_specifier_list)
3134 {

3139  // 'POS' '(' {ConstantIndex ','}+ ')' ':' -> PresetIndexSpecifier {cons("PresetIndexSpecifier")}
3140  // CompileTimeNumericFormula -> ConstantIndex
3141  // CompileTimeStatusFormula -> ConstantIndex
3142 
3143  ATerm t_const_index;
3144 
3145  if (ATmatch(term, "PresetIndexSpecifier(<term>)", &t_const_index)) {
3146  SgExpression* constant_index;
3147 
3148  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_const_index);
3149  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {

3151  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
3152 
3153  constant_index = nullptr;
3154  if (traverse_Formula(head, constant_index)) {

3156  } else return ATfalse;

3158 
3159  index_specifier_list->get_expressions().push_back(constant_index);

3168 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_TablePresetValue(ATerm term, SgExpression* &preset)
3169 {
3170 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
3171  printf("... traverse_TablePresetValue: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
3172 #endif
3173 
3174  ATerm t_rep_count, t_preset_value, t_preset_values, t_index_list;
3175  preset = nullptr;
3176 
3177  if (ATmatch(term, "PresetValueRep(<term>,<term>)", &t_rep_count, &t_preset_values)) {
3178  SgExpression* rep_count = nullptr;
3179  SgExprListExp* values_list = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp_nfi();
3180  setSourcePosition(values_list, t_preset_values);
3181 
3182  if (traverse_Formula(t_rep_count, rep_count)) {
3183  // MATCHED Formula for repetition count
3184  } else return ATfalse;
3185 
3186  // Fill list of PresetValues
3187  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_preset_values);
3188  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
3189  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
3190  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
3191 
3192  SgExpression* preset_value = nullptr;
3193  if (traverse_TablePresetValue(head, preset_value)) {
3194  ASSERT_not_null(preset_value);
3195  values_list->get_expressions().push_back(preset_value);
3196  preset_value->set_parent(values_list);
3197  } else return ATfalse;
3198  }
3199  ASSERT_not_null(rep_count);
3200 
3201  preset = SageBuilder::buildReplicationOp_nfi(rep_count, values_list);
3202  setSourcePosition(preset, term);
3203  }
3204  else if (ATmatch(term, "PresetValuePositioner(<term>,<term>)", &t_index_list, &t_preset_value)) {
3205  SgExprListExp* index_list = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp_nfi();
3206  setSourcePosition(index_list, t_index_list);
3207 
3208  // Fill list of IndexValues
3209  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_index_list);
3210  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
3211  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
3212  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
3213 
3214  SgExpression* index = nullptr;
3215  if (traverse_Formula(head, index)) {
3216  ASSERT_not_null(index);
3217  index_list->get_expressions().push_back(index);
3218  index->set_parent(index_list);
3219  } else return ATfalse;
3220  }
3221 
3222  SgExpression* preset_value = nullptr;
3223  if (traverse_TablePresetValue(t_preset_value, preset_value)) {
3224  // MATCHED TablePresetValue
3225  } else return ATfalse;
3226  ASSERT_not_null(preset_value);
3227 
3228  preset = new SgJovialPresetPositionExp(index_list, preset_value);
3229  ASSERT_not_null(preset);
3230  setSourcePosition(preset, term);
3231  }
3232  else if (ATmatch(term, "PresetValueNone()")) {
3233  preset = SageBuilder::buildNullExpression_nfi();
3234  setSourcePosition(preset, term);
3235  }
3236  else if (traverse_Formula(term, preset)) {
3237  // MATCHED Formula for preset value
3238  }
3239  else return ATfalse;
3240 
3241  ASSERT_not_null(preset);
3242 
3243  return ATtrue;
3244 }

3269 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_ItemTypeDeclaration(ATerm term)
3270 {
3271 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
3272  printf("... traverse_ItemTypeDeclaration: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
3273 #endif
3274 
3275  ATerm t_name, t_type_desc;
3276  std::string name;
3277 
3278  SgType* declared_type = nullptr;
3279 
3280  std::string label = "";
3281 
3282  if (ATmatch(term, "ItemTypeDeclaration(<term>,<term>)", &t_name, &t_type_desc)) {
3283 
3284  if (traverse_Name(t_name, name)) {
3285  // MATCHED ItemTypeName
3286  } else return ATfalse;
3287 
3288  // Look for a StatusItemDescription first
3289  if (match_StatusItemDescription(t_type_desc)) {
3290  SgEnumDeclaration* enum_decl = nullptr;
3291  Sawyer::Optional<SgExpression*> status_size;
3292 
3293  // Begin SageTreeBuilder
3294  sage_tree_builder.Enter(enum_decl, name);
3295  setSourcePosition(enum_decl, term);
3296 
3297  if (traverse_StatusItemDescription(t_type_desc, enum_decl, status_size)) {
3298  if (status_size) {
3299  SgTypeInt* field_type = SageBuilder::buildIntType(*status_size);
3300  enum_decl->set_field_type(field_type);
3301  }
3302 
3303  // End SageTreeBuilder
3304  sage_tree_builder.Leave(enum_decl);
3305  }
3306  else {
3307  mlog[ERROR] << "matched an StatusItemDescription but failed in building an SgEnumDeclaration \n";
3308  ROSE_ABORT();
3309  }
3310  }
3311 
3312  // If not a StatusItemDescription look for an ItemTypeDescription
3313  else if (traverse_ItemTypeDescription(t_type_desc, declared_type)) {
3314  // MATCHED ItemTypeDescription without StatusItemDescription
3315 
3316  ASSERT_not_null(declared_type);
3317 
3318  // Begin SageTreeBuilder
3319  SgTypedefDeclaration* type_def = nullptr;
3320  sage_tree_builder.Enter(type_def, name, declared_type);
3321  setSourcePosition(type_def, term);
3322 
3323  // End SageTreeBuilder
3324  sage_tree_builder.Leave(type_def);
3325  }
3326  }
3327  else return ATfalse;
3328 
3329  return ATtrue;
3330 }

3366 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::
3367 traverse_TableTypeSpecifier(ATerm term, SgJovialTableStatement* table_decl)
3368 {
3369 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
3370  printf("... traverse_TableTypeSpecifier: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
3371 #endif
3372 
3373 // A TableTypeSpecifier looks a base class name or it is a primitive type
3374 //
3375  SgType* base_type{nullptr};
3376  SgJovialTableType* parent_type{nullptr};
3377 
3378  ASSERT_not_null(table_decl);
3379 
3380  ATerm t_dim_list, t_struct_spec, t_like_option, t_entry_spec, t_type_name;
3381  std::string table_type_name;
3382  TableSpecifier table_spec;
3383 
3384  SgJovialTableType* table_type = isSgJovialTableType(table_decl->get_type());
3385  ASSERT_not_null(table_type);
3386 
3387  SgExprListExp* dim_info{table_type->get_dim_info()};
3388 
3389 // TableTypeSpecifier with a name
3390  if (ATmatch(term, "TableTypeSpecifierName(<term>,<term>)", &t_dim_list, &t_type_name)) {
3391 
3392  if (dim_info == nullptr) {
3393  dim_info = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp_nfi();
3394  }
3395 
3396  if (traverse_OptDimensionList(t_dim_list, dim_info)) {
3397  // MATCHED OptDimensionList
3398  } else return ATfalse;
3399 
3400  if (traverse_Name(t_type_name, table_type_name)) {
3401  // MATCHED TableTypeName
3402  } else return ATfalse;
3403 
3404  // This type should have already been created by a type declaration statement, find it
3405  SgClassSymbol* class_symbol = SI::lookupClassSymbolInParentScopes(table_type_name, SB::topScopeStack());
3406  if (class_symbol != nullptr) {
3407  parent_type = isSgJovialTableType(class_symbol->get_type());
3408  }
3409  ASSERT_not_null(parent_type);
3410 
3411  // 1. The class declaration for the base class should be the first non-defining declaration of the base class
3412  // 2. The class definition should be the class definition of the derived class
3413  //
3414  SgClassDeclaration* base_class_decl = isSgClassDeclaration(parent_type->get_declaration());
3415  ASSERT_not_null(base_class_decl);
3416 
3417  // DQ (12/26/2011): The non defining declaration should not have a valid pointer to the class definition.
3418  ROSE_ASSERT(base_class_decl->get_definition() == nullptr);
3419 
3420  SgClassDefinition* derived_class_def = table_decl->get_definition();
3421  ASSERT_not_null(derived_class_def);
3422 
3423  // The sage builder function sets the parent of the base class to the inherited class
3424  // definition and adds the base class to its inheritances list.
3425  SgBaseClass* base_class = SB::buildBaseClass(base_class_decl, derived_class_def, false, /*isDirect*/true);
3426  ASSERT_not_null(base_class);
3427  }
3428 
3429 // TableTypeSpecifier with four arguments where t_entry_spec specifies the type (could be primitive or anonymous)
3430  else if (ATmatch(term, "TableTypeSpecifier(<term>,<term>,<term>,<term>)",
3431  &t_dim_list, &t_struct_spec, &t_like_option, &t_entry_spec)) {
3432 
3433  StructureSpecifier& struct_spec{table_spec.struct_spec};
3434 
3435  if (dim_info == nullptr) {
3436  dim_info = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp_nfi();
3437  }
3438 
3439  if (traverse_OptDimensionList(t_dim_list, dim_info)) {
3440  // MATCHED OptDimensionList
3441  } else return ATfalse;
3442 
3443  // Structure specifier
3444  if (traverse_OptStructureSpecifier(t_struct_spec, struct_spec)) {
3445  // MATCHED OptStructureSpecifier
3446  } else return ATfalse;
3447 
3448  // Like option
3449  if (ATmatch(t_like_option, "no-like-option()")) {
3450  // MATCHED no-like-option
3451  }
3452  else if (ATmatch(t_like_option, "LikeOption(<term>)", &t_type_name)) {
3453  if (traverse_Name(t_type_name, table_type_name)) {
3454  table_decl->set_has_like_option(true);
3455  table_decl->set_like_table_name(table_type_name);
3456  } else return ATfalse;
3457  }
3458  else return ATfalse;
3459 
3460  // TODO - something with these
3461  SgExpression* preset{nullptr};
3462  SgExprListExp* attr_list{nullptr};
3463  LocationSpecifier loc_spec;
3464 
3465  // Entry specifier without a body
3466  if (traverse_EntrySpecifierType(t_entry_spec, base_type, loc_spec, preset, attr_list, table_spec)) {
3467  // MATCHED EntrySpecifier
3468  }
3469  // Entry specifier with a body
3470  else if (traverse_EntrySpecifierBody(t_entry_spec, table_decl, preset, table_spec)) {
3471  // MATCHED EntrySpecifierBody
3472  }
3473  else return ATfalse;
3474 
3475  if (preset) {
3476  mlog[WARN] << "UNIMPLEMENTED: TableTypeSpecifier - preset (This is likely fixed, please confirm)\n";
3477  ASSERT_require(preset == nullptr);
3478  }
3479  if (attr_list) {
3480  mlog[WARN] << "UNIMPLEMENTED: TableTypeSpecifier - attr_list\n";
3481  ASSERT_require(attr_list == nullptr);
3482  }
3483  }
3484  else return ATfalse;
3485 
3486  table_type->set_dim_info(dim_info);
3487  dim_info->set_parent(table_type);
3488 
3489  if (base_type) {
3490  table_type->set_base_type(base_type);
3491  base_type->set_parent(table_type);
3492  }
3493 
3494 // Set the structure specifier if present
3495  StructureSpecifier& struct_spec{table_spec.struct_spec};
3496  if (struct_spec.is_parallel) {
3497  table_type->set_structure_specifier(StrucSpecEnum::e_parallel);
3498  }
3499  else if (struct_spec.is_tight) {
3500  table_type->set_structure_specifier(StrucSpecEnum::e_tight);
3501  table_type->set_bits_per_entry(struct_spec.bits_per_entry);
3502  }
3503 
3504  return ATtrue;
3505 }
3506 
3507 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_BlockTypeDeclaration(ATerm term)
3508 {
3509 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
3510  printf("... traverse_BlockTypeDeclaration: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
3511 #endif
3512 
3513  ATerm t_name, t_type_desc, t_order;
3514  std::string type_name;

3516  SgJovialTableStatement* block_decl = nullptr;
3517  bool hasBlockDirective = false;

3519  if (ATmatch(term, "BlockTypeDeclaration(<term>,<term>)", &t_name, &t_type_desc)) {
3520  hasBlockDirective = false;
3521  }
3522  else if (ATmatch(term, "BlockOrderedTypeDeclaration(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_name, &t_order, &t_type_desc)) {
3523  hasBlockDirective = true;
3524  }
3525  else return ATfalse;
3526 
3527  if (traverse_Name(t_name, type_name)) {
3528  // MATCHED BlockTypeName

3530 
3531  // Begin SageTreeBuilder
3532  RB::SourcePositionPair sources;
3533  sage_tree_builder.Enter(block_decl, type_name, sources, /*is_block*/ true);
3534  setSourcePosition(block_decl, term);
3535 
3536  if (hasBlockDirective) {
3537  if (traverse_Directive(t_order)) {
3538  // MATCHED OrderDirective
3539  } else return ATfalse;
3540  }
3541 
3542  if (traverse_BlockBodyPart(t_type_desc, block_decl)) {
3543  // MATCHED BlockBodyPart
3544  }
3545  else if (traverse_DataDeclaration(t_type_desc)) {
3546  // MATCHED DataDeclaration -> BlockBodyPart
3547  }
3548  else if (traverse_NullDeclaration(t_type_desc)) {
3549  // MATCHED NullDeclaration -> BlockBodyPart
3550  }
3551  else return ATfalse;
3552 
3553  // End SageTreeBuilder
3554  sage_tree_builder.Leave(block_decl);
3555 
3556  return ATtrue;
