3559 //========================================================================================
3560 // 2.3 STATEMENT NAME DECLARATIONS
3561 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3562 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_StatementNameDeclaration(ATerm term, int def_or_ref)
3563 {
3564 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
3565  printf("... traverse_StatementNameDeclaration: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
3566 #endif
3567 
3568  //'LABEL' {StatementName ','}+ ';' -> StatementNameDeclaration {cons("StatementNameDeclaration")}
3569 
3570  ATerm t_name;
3571  std::string name;
3572 
3573  // Note: Can be a name list, not just a name.
3574  // Currently a separate SgLabelStatement is created for each name.
3575  //
3576  if (ATmatch(term, "StatementNameDeclaration(<term>)", &t_name)) {
3577  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_name);
3578  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
3579  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
3580  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
3581  if (traverse_Name(head, name)) {
3582  auto labelType{SgLabelStatement::e_jovial_label_decl};
3583  if (def_or_ref == LanguageTranslation::e_storage_modifier_jovial_def) {
3584  labelType = SgLabelStatement::e_jovial_label_def;
3585  } else if (def_or_ref == LanguageTranslation::e_storage_modifier_jovial_ref) {
3586  labelType = SgLabelStatement::e_jovial_label_ref;
3587  }
3588 
3589  // Make a separate label statement for each name in the list
3590  //
3591  // WARNING: Do not use SageTreeBuilder!
3592  // A StatementNameDeclaration should not create a symbol, it is effectively a noop,
3593  // as it is not needed for normal label handling and may get in the way, see gitlab-issue.310.jov
3594  // Thus statement creation has to be done here, can't even use SageBuilder.
3595  //
3596  // Standard (MIL-STD-1589C) states that <statement-name-declaration> must either be a
3597  // <formal-input-parameter> to the subroutine containing the <statement-name-declaration>
3598  // or else must be used in a <label> in the immediate scope containing the
3599  // <statement-name-declaration> (i.e., no including nested scopes), or else
3600  // the <statement-name-declaration> must be a <ref-specification-choice>
3601  //
3602  // NOTE: Perhaps a symbol is created by later processing, to encourage correct label handling,
3603  // see gitlab-issue-{310,343,345}, create an SgStringVal and save it for later. If not
3604  // needed it will need to be deleted.
3605  //
3606 
3607  SgLabelStatement* labelStmt = new SgLabelStatement(name, /*statement*/nullptr);
3608 
3609  setSourcePosition(labelStmt, head);
3610  labelStmt->set_label_type(labelType);
3611 
3612  // Save an SgStringVal for later processing (if needed)
3613  auto stringVal = SB::buildStringVal_nfi(name);
3614  labelDecls_.insert(std::make_pair(name, stringVal));
3615 
3616  SI::appendStatement(labelStmt, SB::topScopeStack());
3617  }
3618  else return ATfalse;
3619  }
3620  }
3621  else return ATfalse;
3622 
3623  return ATtrue;
3624 }

3678 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_FormalDefineParameterList(ATerm term, std::string &params)
3679 {
3680 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
3681  printf("... traverse_FormalDefineParameterList: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
3682 #endif
3683 
3684  ATerm t_param_list;
3685  char* letter;
3686 
3687  if (ATmatch(term, "no-formal-define-parameter-list")) {
3688  // MATCHED no-formal-define-parameter-list
3689  }
3690  else if (ATmatch(term, "FormalDefineParameterList(<term>)", &t_param_list)) {
3691  // There is a FormalDefinParameterList. For now just reassemble it to be
3692  // passed on to ROSE to be similar to #define in C. Assume jovial front-end
3693  // compiler will handle macro substitution.
3694  //
3695 
3696  // add initial parens
3697  params += '(';
3698 
3699  bool first = true;
3700  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_param_list);
3701  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
3702  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
3703  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
3704 
3705  // add comma separator
3706  if (first == false) params += ',';
3707  first = false;
3708 
3709  if (ATmatch(head, "FormalDefineParameter(<str>)", &letter)) {
3710  // MATCHED Letter
3711  params += letter;
3712  } else return ATfalse;
3713  }
3714  }
3715  else return ATfalse;
3716 
3717  // add terminating parens
3718  if (params.length() > 0) params += ')';
3719 
3720  return ATtrue;
3721 }

3723 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_DefineString(ATerm term, std::string & def_string)
3724 {
3725 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
3726  printf("... traverse_DefineString: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
3727 #endif
3728 
3729  // Need to remove the "?" at the beginning and end of each string
3730  char* str;
3731 
3732  if (ATmatch(term, "DefineString(<str>)", &str)) {
3733  // MATCHED DefineString
3734  def_string = str;
3735  } else return ATfalse;
3736 
3737  // To make lexing and parsing possible it was necessary to replace the
3738  // starting and terminating double quotes '"' with '?'. Fix this
3739  // here.
3740  //
3741  unsigned int len = def_string.length();
3742  ROSE_ASSERT(len > 1);
3743  ROSE_ASSERT(def_string[0] == '?' && def_string[len-1] == '?');
3744 
3745  def_string[0] = '"';
3746  def_string[len-1] = '"';
3747 
3748  return ATtrue;
3749 }

3934 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_OverlayDeclaration(ATerm term)
3935 {
3936 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
3937  printf("... traverse_OverlayDeclaration: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
3938 #endif
3939 
3940  // 'OVERLAY'
3941  // OptAbsoluteAddress
3942  // OverlayExpression ';' -> OverlayDeclaration {cons("OverlayDeclaration")}
3943 
3944  ATerm t_addr, t_absolute_addr, t_expr;
3945 
3946  SgJovialOverlayDeclaration* overlay_decl = nullptr;
3947 
3948  if (ATmatch(term, "OverlayDeclaration(<term>,<term>)", &t_addr, &t_expr)) {
3949  SgExpression* address = nullptr;
3950  SgExprListExp* overlay_expr = nullptr;
3951 
3952  if (ATmatch(t_addr, "AbsoluteAddress(<term>)", &t_absolute_addr)) {
3953  // 'POS' '(' OverlayAddress ')' -> AbsoluteAddress {cons("AbsoluteAddress")}
3954  if (traverse_Formula(t_absolute_addr, address)) {
3955  // MATCHED OverlayAddress
3956  // CompileTimeNumericFormula -> OverlayAddress
3957  } else return ATfalse;
3958  }
3959  else if (ATmatch(t_addr, "no-absolute-address")) {
3960  address = SageBuilder::buildNullExpression_nfi();
3961  }
3962  else return ATfalse;
3963 
3964  if (traverse_OverlayExpression(t_expr, overlay_expr)) {
3965  // MATCHED OverlayExpression
3966  } else return ATfalse;
3967  ASSERT_not_null(overlay_expr);
3968 
3969  // Begin SageTreeBuilder
3970  sage_tree_builder.Enter(overlay_decl, address, overlay_expr);
3971  setSourcePosition(overlay_decl, term);
3972  }
3973  else return ATfalse;
3974 
3975  ASSERT_not_null(overlay_decl);
3976 
3977 // End SageTreeBuilder
3978  sage_tree_builder.Leave(overlay_decl);
3979 
3980  return ATtrue;
3981 }

3983 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_OverlayExpression(ATerm term, SgExprListExp* &overlay_expr)

3987 #endif
3988  // {OverlayString ':'}+ -> OverlayExpression
3989 
3990  SgExprListExp* overlay_string;
3991  overlay_expr = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp_nfi();
3992  setSourcePosition(overlay_expr, term);
3993 
3994  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", term);
3995  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
3996  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
3997  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
3998 
3999  overlay_string = nullptr;
4000  if (traverse_OverlayString(head, overlay_string)) {
4001  // MATCHED OverlayString
4002  } else return ATfalse;
4003  ASSERT_not_null(overlay_string);
4004 
4005  overlay_expr->get_expressions().push_back(overlay_string);
4006  overlay_string->set_parent(overlay_expr);
4007  }
4008 
4009  return ATtrue;
4010 }

4042 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_OverlayElement(ATerm term, SgExpression* &overlay_element)
4043 {
4044 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
4045  printf("... traverse_OverlayElement: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
4046 #endif
4047 
4048  // Spacer -> OverlayElement
4049  // DataName -> OverlayElement
4050  // '(' OverlayExpression ')' -> OverlayElement {cons("OverlayElement")}
4051 
4052  ATerm t_expr;
4053  std::string name;
4054 
4055  // Could make a new node, SgJovialOverlayElement. However, following convention used for now:
4056  // 1. Spacer is a SgExpression;
4057  // 2. DataName is a SgVarRefExp
4058  // 3. OverlayExpression is a SgExprListExp
4059 
4060  SgExpression* spacer = nullptr;
4061  SgVarRefExp* data_name = nullptr;
4062  SgExprListExp* overlay_expr = nullptr;
4063 
4064  if (ATmatch(term, "OverlayElement(<term>)", &t_expr)) {
4065  if (traverse_OverlayExpression(t_expr, overlay_expr)) {
4066  ASSERT_not_null(overlay_expr);
4067  setSourcePosition(overlay_expr, t_expr);
4068  overlay_element = overlay_expr;
4069  } else return ATfalse;
4070  }
4071  else if (traverse_Spacer(term, spacer)) {
4072  ASSERT_not_null(spacer);
4073  setSourcePosition(spacer, term);
4074  overlay_element = spacer;
4075  }
4076  else if (traverse_Name(term, name)) {
4077  data_name = SB::buildVarRefExp(name, SB::topScopeStack());
4078  setSourcePosition(data_name, term);
4079  overlay_element = data_name;
4080  } else return ATfalse;
4081 
4082  ASSERT_not_null(overlay_element);
4083 
4084  return ATtrue;
4085 }

4106 //========================================================================================
4107 // 3.1 PROCEDURES
4108 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4109 
4110 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_ProcedureDeclaration(ATerm term, LanguageTranslation::FunctionModifierList &modifiers)
4111 {
4112 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
4113  printf("... traverse_ProcedureDeclaration: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
4114 #endif
4115 
4116  ATerm t_proc_heading, t_directives, t_decl;
4117 
4118  std::string name;
4119  std::list<FormalParameter> param_name_list;
4120  std::vector<RB::Token> comments{};
4121 
4122  SgFunctionDeclaration* function_decl{nullptr};
4123  SgFunctionParameterList* param_list{nullptr};
4124  SgScopeStatement* param_scope{nullptr};
4125  bool is_defining_decl{true};
4126 
4127  if (ATmatch(term, "ProcedureDeclaration(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_proc_heading, &t_directives, &t_decl)) {
4128  // Save any comments preceding ProcedureDeclaration
4129  sage_tree_builder.consumePrecedingComments(comments, getLocation(term));
4130 
4131  if (traverse_ProcedureHeading(t_proc_heading, name, param_name_list, modifiers)) {
4132  // MATCHED ProcedureHeading
4133  } else return ATfalse;
4134 
4135  is_defining_decl = ! sage_tree_builder.list_contains(modifiers, e_function_modifier_reference);
4136 
4137  // Enter SageTreeBuilder for SgFunctionParameterList
4138  sage_tree_builder.Enter(param_list, param_scope, name, nullptr, is_defining_decl);
4139 
4140  if (traverse_DirectiveList(t_directives)) {
4141  // MATCHED PostProcDirective*
4142  } else return ATfalse;
4143 
4144  // These declarations will stored in the function parameter scope
4145  if (traverse_Declaration(t_decl)) {
4146  // MATCHED Declaration
4147  } else return ATfalse;
4148 
4149  // Leave SageTreeBuilder for SgFunctionParameterList
4150  sage_tree_builder.Leave(param_list, param_scope, param_name_list);
4151  }
4152  else return ATfalse;
4153 
4154  RB::SourcePosition heading_start, heading_end; // start and end of ProcedureHeading
4155  RB::SourcePosition decl_start, decl_end; // start and end of Declaration
4156  setSourcePositions(t_proc_heading, heading_start, heading_end);
4157  setSourcePositions(t_decl, decl_start, decl_end);
4158 
4159  RB::SourcePositions sources(heading_start, decl_start, decl_end);
4160 
4161 // Enter SageTreeBuilder for SgFunctionDeclaration
4162  sage_tree_builder.Enter(function_decl, name, /*return_type*/nullptr,
4163  param_list, modifiers, is_defining_decl, sources, comments);
4164 
4165 // Leave SageTreeBuilder for SgFunctionDeclaration
4166  sage_tree_builder.Leave(function_decl, param_scope);
4167 
4168  return ATtrue;
4169 }
4170 
4171 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_ProcedureDefinition(ATerm term, LanguageTranslation::FunctionModifierList &modifiers)
4172 {
4173 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
4174  printf("... traverse_ProcedureDefinition: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
4175 #endif
4176 
4177  ATerm t_proc_heading, t_directives, t_proc_body;
4178 
4179  std::string name{};
4180  std::list<FormalParameter> param_name_list{};
4181  std::vector<RB::Token> comments{};
4182 
4183  SgFunctionDeclaration* function_decl{nullptr};
4184  SgFunctionParameterList* param_list{nullptr};
4185  SgScopeStatement* param_scope{nullptr};
4186  bool is_defining_decl{true};
4187 
4188  if (ATmatch(term, "ProcedureDefinition(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_proc_heading, &t_directives, &t_proc_body)) {
4189  // Save comments preceding body, otherwise they will be consumed by SubroutineBody
4190  sage_tree_builder.consumePrecedingComments(comments, getLocation(t_proc_body));
4191 
4192  if (traverse_ProcedureHeading(t_proc_heading, name, param_name_list, modifiers)) {
4193  // MATCHED ProcedureHeading
4194  } else return ATfalse;
4195 
4196  // Enter SageTreeBuilder for SgFunctionParameterList
4197  sage_tree_builder.Enter(param_list, param_scope, name, nullptr, is_defining_decl);
4198 
4199  if (traverse_DirectiveList(t_directives)) {
4200  // MATCHED PostProcDirective*
4201  } else return ATfalse;
4202 
4203  // These declarations will stored in the function parameter scope
4204  if (traverse_SubroutineBody(t_proc_body)) {
4205  // MATCHED ProcedureBody (the production is actually a SubroutineBody)
4206  } else return ATfalse;
4207 
4208  // Leave SageTreeBuilder for SgFunctionParameterList
4209  sage_tree_builder.Leave(param_list, param_scope, param_name_list);
4210  }
4211  else return ATfalse;
4212 
4213  RB::SourcePosition proc_start, proc_end; // start and end of ProcedureDefinition
4214  RB::SourcePosition body_start, body_end; // start and end of SubroutineBody
4215  setSourcePositions(term, proc_start, proc_end);
4216  setSourcePositions(t_proc_body, body_start, body_end);
4217 
4218  RB::SourcePositions sources(proc_start, body_start, proc_end);
4219 
4220 // Enter SageTreeBuilder for SgFunctionDeclaration
4221  sage_tree_builder.Enter(function_decl, name, /*return_type*/nullptr,
4222  param_list, modifiers, is_defining_decl, sources, comments);
4223 
4224 // Leave SageTreeBuilder for SgFunctionDeclaration
4225  sage_tree_builder.Leave(function_decl, param_scope);
4226 
4227 // Remaining source positions (last, comment processing may conflict with Leave() calls)
4228  setSourcePosition(param_list, t_proc_heading);
4229

4515 #endif
4516 
4517  ATerm t_name, t_type, t_attr, t_params;
4518 
4519 // For StatusItemDescription
4520  Sawyer::Optional<SgExpression*> status_size;
4521  SgEnumDeclaration* enum_decl = nullptr;
4522 
4523  type = nullptr;
4524 
4525  if (ATmatch(term, "FunctionHeading(<term>,<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_name, &t_attr, &t_params, &t_type)) {
4526  if (traverse_Name(t_name, name)) {
4527  // MATCHED Name
4528  } else return ATfalse;
4529 
4530  if (traverse_SubroutineAttribute(t_attr, modifiers)) {
4531  // MATCHED SubroutineAttribute
4532  } else return ATfalse;
4533 
4534  if (traverse_FormalParameterList(t_params, param_list)) {
4535  // MATCHED FormalParameterList
4536  } else return ATfalse;
4537 
4538  if (traverse_ItemTypeDescription(t_type, type)) {
4539  // MATCHED ItemTypeDescription without StatusItemDescription
4540  }
4541  else if (traverse_StatusItemDescription(t_type, enum_decl, status_size)) {
4542  // MATCHED StatusItemDescription: must be handled differently than other ItemTypeDescriptions
4543  // because they require different arguments
4544  mlog[ERROR] << "UNIMPLEMENTED: FunctionHeading - StatusItemDescription";
4545  ROSE_ABORT();
4546  }
4547  else return ATfalse;
4548  }
4549  else return ATfalse;
4550 
4551  return ATtrue;

4783 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_SimpleStatement(ATerm term)
4784 {

4786  printf("... traverse_SimpleStatement: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
4787 #endif
4788 
4789  ATerm t_labels, t_stmt;
4790  std::vector<std::string> labels;
4791  std::vector<PosInfo> locations;
4792 
4793  if (ATmatch(term, "NullStatement()")) {
4794  // MATCHED NullStatement (SimpleStatement without a label)
4795  }
4796 
4797  else if (ATmatch(term, "SimpleStatement(<term>,<term>)", &t_labels, &t_stmt)) {
4798  if (traverse_LabelList(t_labels, labels, locations)) {
4799  // MATCHED LabelList
4800  } else return ATfalse;
4801 
4802  if (traverse_AssignmentStatement(t_stmt, labels)) {
4803  // MATCHED AssignmentStatement
4804  }
4805  else if (traverse_NullStatement(t_stmt, labels)) {
4806  // MATCHED NullStatement
4807  }
4808  else if (traverse_NullBlockStatement(t_stmt)) {
4809  // MATCHED NullStatement
4810  if (labels.size() > 0) mlog[WARN] << "UNIMPLEMENTED labels: NullBlockStatement: labels.size() > 0\n";
4811  }
4812  else return ATfalse;
4813  }
4814 
4815 // This subsumes the labels in statements, eventually all SimpleStatements will take this path
4816  else if (ATmatch(term, "SimpleStatement(<term>)", &t_stmt)) {
4817  if (traverse_IfStatement(t_stmt)) {
4818  // MATCHED IfStatement
4819  }
4820  else if (traverse_AbortStatement(t_stmt)) {
4821  // MATCHED AbortStatement
4822  }
4823  else if (traverse_StopStatement(t_stmt)) {
4824  // MATCHED StopStatement
4825  }
4826  else if (traverse_ExitStatement(t_stmt)) {
4827  // MATCHED ExitStatement
4828  }
4829  else if (traverse_GotoStatement(t_stmt)) {
4830  // MATCHED GotoStatement
4831  }
4832  else if (traverse_ReturnStatement(t_stmt)) {
4833  // MATCHED ReturnStatement
4834  }
4835  else if (traverse_CaseStatement(t_stmt)) {
4836  // MATCHED CaseStatement
4837  }
4838  else if (traverse_WhileStatement(t_stmt)) {
4839  // MATCHED WhileStatement
4840  }
4841  else if (traverse_ForStatement(t_stmt)) {
4842  // MATCHED ForStatement
4843  }
4844  else if (traverse_ProcedureCallStatement(t_stmt)) {
4845  // MATCHED ProcedureCallStatement
4846  }
4847  else return ATfalse;
4848  }
4849  else return ATfalse;
4850 
4851  return ATtrue;
4852 }

4854 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_CompoundStatement(ATerm term)
4855 {

4858 #endif
4859 
4860  ATerm t_labels, t_stmt, t_labels2;
4861  std::vector<std::string> labels, labels2;
4862  std::vector<PosInfo> locations, locations2;
4863 
4864  SgBasicBlock* block = nullptr;
4865 
4866  if (ATmatch(term, "CompoundStatement(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_labels, &t_stmt, &t_labels2)) {
4867  if (traverse_LabelList(t_labels, labels, locations)) {
4868  // MATCHED LabelList
4869  } else return ATfalse;
4870 
4871  // Begin SageTreeBuilder
4872  sage_tree_builder.Enter(block, labels);
4873  setSourcePosition(block, term, false);
4874 
4875  if (traverse_StatementList(t_stmt)) {
4876  // MATCHED StatementList
4877  } else return ATfalse;
4878 
4879  if (traverse_LabelList(t_labels2, labels2, locations2)) {
4880  // MATCHED LabelList
4881  } else return ATfalse;
4882 
4883  // TODO: Move to Leave?
4884  sage_tree_builder.attachComments(block, getLocation(term), true);
4885  }
4886  else return ATfalse;
4887 
4888  ASSERT_not_null(block);
4889 
4890 // End SageTreeBuilder
4891  sage_tree_builder.Leave(block, labels2);

4956 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_LabelList(ATerm term, std::vector<std::string> &labels, std::vector<PosInfo> &locations)
4957 {
4958 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
4959  printf("... traverse_LabelList: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
4960 #endif
4961 
4962  ATerm t_labels;
4963  char* label;
4964 
4965  if (ATmatch(term, "LabelList(<term>)" , &t_labels)) {
4966  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_labels);
4967  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
4968  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
4969  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
4970  if (ATmatch(head, "Label(<str>)", &label)) {
4971  labels.push_back(label);
4972  locations.push_back(getLocation(head));
4973  } else return ATfalse;
4974  }
4975  } else return ATfalse;
4976 
4977  return ATtrue;
4978 }

5025 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_WhileStatement(ATerm term)

5032  std::vector<std::string> labels;

5034 
5035  SgWhileStmt* while_stmt = nullptr;
5036  SgExpression* condition = nullptr;
5037 
5038  if (ATmatch(term, "WhileStatement(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_labels, &t_clause, &t_stmt)) {
5039  if (traverse_LabelList(t_labels, labels, locations)) {
5040  // MATCHED LabelList
5041  } else return ATfalse;
5042 
5043  if (ATmatch(t_clause, "WhileClause(<term>)", &t_formula)) {
5044  if (traverse_Formula(t_formula, condition)) {
5045  // MATCHED Formula
5046  } else return ATfalse;

5048  else return ATfalse;
5049 
5050  // Begin SageTreeBuilder
5051  sage_tree_builder.Enter(while_stmt, condition);
5052  setSourcePosition(while_stmt, term);
5053 
5054  // Match ControlledStatement -- this is the body
5055  if (traverse_Statement(t_stmt)) {
5056  // MATCHED Statement
5057  } else return ATfalse;
5058  }
5059  else return ATfalse;
5060 
5061 // End SageTreeBuilder
5062  sage_tree_builder.Leave(while_stmt);

5067 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_ForStatement(ATerm term)
5068 {
5069 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
5070  printf("... traverse_ForStatement: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
5071 #endif
5072 
5073  ATerm t_labels, t_clause, t_stmt;
5074  std::vector<std::string> labels;
5075  std::vector<PosInfo> locations;
5076 
5077  SgExpression* var_ref = nullptr;
5078  SgExpression* init = nullptr;
5079  SgExpression* phrase1 = nullptr;
5080  SgExpression* phrase2 = nullptr;
5081 
5082  int phrase1_enum = Jovial_ROSE_Translation::e_unknown;
5083  int phrase2_enum = Jovial_ROSE_Translation::e_unknown;
5084  SgJovialForThenStatement::loop_statement_type_enum loop_type_enum = SgJovialForThenStatement::e_unknown;
5085 
5086  SgExpression* while_expr = nullptr;
5087  SgExpression* by_or_then_expr = nullptr;
5088  SgJovialForThenStatement* for_stmt = nullptr;
5089 
5090  if (ATmatch(term, "ForStatement(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_labels, &t_clause, &t_stmt)) {
5091  if (traverse_LabelList(t_labels, labels, locations)) {
5092  // MATCHED LabelList
5093  } else return ATfalse;
5094 
5095  // Begin SageTreeBuilder
5096  sage_tree_builder.Enter(for_stmt);
5097  setSourcePosition(for_stmt, term);
5098 
5099  // Control variable goes in the for statement scope, not in its body
5100  // The normal pattern of SageTreeBuilder is to push a statement scope
5101  // and then its body. Break that pattern here because the control
5102  // variable is seen after the for statement is constructed.
5103  SB::popScopeStack(); // for_stmt loop body
5104 
5105  if (traverse_ForClause(t_clause, var_ref, init, phrase1, phrase2, phrase1_enum, phrase2_enum)) {
5106  // MATCHED ForClause
5107  } else return ATfalse;
5108 
5109  ASSERT_not_null(var_ref);
5110  ASSERT_not_null(init);
5111 
5112  SgAssignOp* initialization = SageBuilder::buildAssignOp_nfi(var_ref, init);
5113  setSourcePosition(initialization, t_clause);
5114 
5115  // WHILE then optional BY or THEN (increment expression)
5116  if (phrase1_enum == e_while_phrase_expr) {
5117  while_expr = phrase1;
5118  by_or_then_expr = phrase2;
5119  if (phrase2_enum == e_by_phrase_expr) {
5120  loop_type_enum = SgJovialForThenStatement::e_for_while_by_stmt;
5121  }
5122  else if (phrase2_enum == e_then_phrase_expr) {
5123  loop_type_enum = SgJovialForThenStatement::e_for_while_then_stmt;
5124  }
5125  else if (phrase2_enum == Jovial_ROSE_Translation::e_unknown) {
5126  loop_type_enum = SgJovialForThenStatement::e_for_while_stmt;
5127  }
5128  }
5129  // BY (increment expression) then optional WHILE
5130  else if (phrase1_enum == e_by_phrase_expr) {
5131  while_expr = phrase2;
5132  by_or_then_expr = phrase1;
5133  loop_type_enum = SgJovialForThenStatement::e_for_by_while_stmt;
5134  }
5135  // THEN (increment expression) then optional WHILE
5136  else if (phrase1_enum == e_then_phrase_expr) {
5137  while_expr = phrase2;
5138  by_or_then_expr = phrase1;
5139  loop_type_enum = SgJovialForThenStatement::e_for_then_while_stmt;
5140  }
5141  // No WHILE, THEN, or BY expressions
5142  else {
5143  loop_type_enum = SgJovialForThenStatement::e_for_only_stmt;
5144  }
5145  ROSE_ASSERT(loop_type_enum != SgJovialForThenStatement::e_unknown);
5146  ASSERT_not_null(for_stmt);
5147 
5148  for_stmt->set_initialization(initialization);
5149  for_stmt->set_while_expression(while_expr);
5150  for_stmt->set_by_or_then_expression(by_or_then_expr);
5151  for_stmt->set_loop_statement_type(loop_type_enum);
5152 
5153  if (initialization) initialization->set_parent(for_stmt);
5154  if (while_expr) while_expr->set_parent(for_stmt);
5155  if (by_or_then_expr) by_or_then_expr->set_parent(for_stmt);
5156 
5157  // Attach comments after ForClause and before body
5158  if (while_expr) {
5159  sage_tree_builder.attachComments(while_expr, getLocation(t_clause), /*at_end*/true);
5160  }
5161  sage_tree_builder.attachComments(for_stmt->get_loop_body(), getLocation(t_stmt));
5162 
5163  // Now the scope of the for loop body should be used
5164  SB::pushScopeStack(for_stmt->get_loop_body());
5165 
5166  // Match ControlledStatement (body of loop)
5167  if (traverse_Statement(t_stmt)) {
5168  // MATCHED Statement
5169  } else return ATfalse;
5170  }
5171  else return ATfalse;
5172 
5173 // End SageTreeBuilder
5174  sage_tree_builder.Leave(for_stmt);
5175 
5176  return ATtrue;
5177 }
5178 
5179 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_ForClause(ATerm term, SgExpression* &var_ref, SgExpression* &init,
5180  SgExpression* &phrase1, SgExpression* &phrase2,
5181  int &phrase1_enum, int &phrase2_enum)
5182 {
5183 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
5184  printf("... traverse_ForClause: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
5185 #endif
5186 
5187  ATerm t_item, t_clause;
5188  char* var_name;
5189 
5190  init = nullptr;
5191  var_ref = nullptr;
5192  phrase1 = nullptr;
5193  phrase2 = nullptr;
5194  phrase1_enum = Jovial_ROSE_Translation::e_unknown;
5195  phrase2_enum = Jovial_ROSE_Translation::e_unknown;
5196 
5197  if (ATmatch(term, "ForClause(<term>,<term>)", &t_item, &t_clause)) {
5198  // MATCHED ForClause
5199 
5200  if (ATmatch(t_item, "<str>" , &var_name)) {
5201  // MATCHED ControlItem
5202  SgVarRefExp* typedVarRef{nullptr};
5203  sage_tree_builder.Enter(typedVarRef, var_name, true);
5204  sage_tree_builder.Leave(typedVarRef);
5205 
5206  var_ref = typedVarRef;
5207  setSourcePosition(var_ref, t_item);
5208  }
5209  else return ATfalse;
5210 
5211  if (traverse_ControlClause(t_clause, init, phrase1, phrase2, phrase1_enum, phrase2_enum)) {
5212  // MATCHED ControlClause
5213  } else return ATfalse;
5214  }
5215  else return ATfalse;
5216 
5217  ASSERT_not_null(var_ref);
5218  return ATtrue;
5219 }

5221 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_ControlClause(ATerm term, SgExpression* &initial_value,

5224 {

5229  ATerm t_value, t_continuation;

5231  initial_value = nullptr;
5232  phrase1 = nullptr;
5233  phrase2 = nullptr;

5238  // MATCHED ControlClause

5240  // MATCHED InitialValue

5242  if (traverse_OptContinuation(t_continuation, phrase1, phrase2, phrase1_enum, phrase2_enum)) {
5243  // MATCHED OptContinuation

5245  }
5246  else return ATfalse;

5272 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_Continuation(ATerm term, SgExpression* &phrase1, SgExpression* &phrase2,

5287  // MATCHED no-while-phrase

5301 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_Phrase(ATerm term, SgExpression* &expr, int &phrase_enum)
5302 {
5303 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
5304  printf("... traverse_Phrase: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
5305 #endif
5306 
5307  ATerm t_formula;
5308 
5309  expr = nullptr;
5310  phrase_enum = Jovial_ROSE_Translation::e_unknown;
5311 
5312  if (ATmatch(term, "ByPhrase(<term>)", &t_formula)) {
5313  // MATCHED ByPhrase
5314  if (traverse_Formula(t_formula, expr)){
5315  // MATCHED Formula
5316  phrase_enum = Jovial_ROSE_Translation::e_by_phrase_expr;
5317  } else return ATfalse;
5318  } else if (ATmatch(term, "ThenPhrase(<term>)", &t_formula)) {
5319  // MATCHED ThenPhrase
5320  if (traverse_Formula(t_formula, expr)){
5321  // MATCHED Formula
5322  phrase_enum = Jovial_ROSE_Translation::e_then_phrase_expr;
5323  } else return ATfalse;
5324  } else if (ATmatch(term, "WhilePhrase(<term>)", &t_formula)) {
5325  // MATCHED WhilePhrase
5326  if (traverse_Formula(t_formula, expr)){
5327  // BooleanFormula generalized to Formula
5328  phrase_enum = Jovial_ROSE_Translation::e_while_phrase_expr;
5329  } else return ATfalse;
5330  }
5331 
5332  return ATtrue;
5333 }

5335 //========================================================================================
5336 // 4.3 IF STATEMENTS
5337 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5338 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_IfStatement(ATerm term)
5339 {
5340 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
5341  printf("... traverse_IfStatement: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
5342 #endif
5343 
5344  ATerm t_labels, t_if, t_cond, t_else, t_true, t_false;
5345  std::vector<std::string> labels{};
5346  std::vector<PosInfo> locations{};
5347  std::vector<RB::Token> before_if_comments{};
5348  SgExpression* conditional{nullptr};
5349  SgBasicBlock* true_body{nullptr};
5350  SgBasicBlock* false_body{nullptr};
5351  SgIfStmt* if_stmt{nullptr};
5352 
5353  bool hasElseClause;
5354  if (ATmatch(term, "IfSimpleStatement(<term>,<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_labels,&t_if,&t_cond,&t_true)) {
5355  // MATCHED IfSimpleStatement
5356  hasElseClause = false;
5357  }
5358  else if (ATmatch(term, "IfElseStatement(<term>,<term>,<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_labels,&t_if,&t_cond,&t_true,&t_else)) {
5359  // MATCHED IfElseStatement
5360  hasElseClause = true;
5361  }
5362  else return ATfalse;
5363 
5364  // Save any comments preceding IfStatement
5365  sage_tree_builder.consumePrecedingComments(before_if_comments, getLocation(term));
5366 
5367  if (traverse_LabelList(t_labels, labels, locations)) {
5368  // MATCHED LabelList
5369  } else return ATfalse;
5370 
5371  // t_if is the keyword 'IF'
5372 
5373  if (traverse_Formula(t_cond, conditional)) {
5374  // BooleanFormula generalized to Formula
5375  }
5376  else return ATfalse;
5377 
5378  // Create a basic block and push it on the scope stack so there is
5379  // a place for statements.
5380  true_body = SB::buildBasicBlock_nfi(SB::topScopeStack());
5381  setSourcePosition(true_body, t_true, /*attach_comments*/true);
5382  SageBuilder::pushScopeStack(true_body);
5383 
5384  if (traverse_Statement(t_true)) {
5385  // MATCHED Statement for the true body
5386  } else return ATfalse;
5387 
5388  // Attach comments above and at end of line of true_body
5389  sage_tree_builder.popScopeStack(/*attach_comments*/true);
5390 
5391  if (hasElseClause && ATmatch(t_else, "ElseClause(<term>)", &t_false)) {
5392  // Save and then attach comments before ELSE clause
5393  std::vector<RB::Token> before_else_comments{};
5394  sage_tree_builder.consumePrecedingComments(before_else_comments, getLocation(t_else));
5395  sage_tree_builder.attachComments(true_body, before_else_comments, /*at_end*/true);
5396 
5397  // There is a false body
5398  false_body = SB::buildBasicBlock_nfi(SB::topScopeStack());
5399  setSourcePosition(false_body, t_false, /*attach_comments*/true);
5400  SageBuilder::pushScopeStack(false_body);
5401 
5402  if (traverse_Statement(t_false)) {
5403  // MATCHED Statement for the false body
5404  } else return ATfalse;
5405 
5406  // Attach comments above and at end of line of true_body
5407  sage_tree_builder.popScopeStack(/*attach_comments*/true);
5408  }
5409 
5410 // Begin SageTreeBuilder
5411  sage_tree_builder.Enter(if_stmt, conditional, true_body, false_body, before_if_comments);
5412  setSourcePosition(if_stmt, term, /*attach_comments*/false);
5413 
5414 // End SageTreeBuilder
5415  sage_tree_builder.Leave(if_stmt, labels);
5416 
5417  return ATtrue;
5418 }
5419 
5420 //========================================================================================
5421 // 4.4 CASE STATEMENTS
5422 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5423 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_CaseStatement(ATerm term)
5424 {
5425 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
5426  printf("... traverse_CaseStatement: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
5427 #endif
5428 
5429  ATerm t_labels, t_formula, t_case_body, t_labels2;
5430  std::vector<std::string> labels, labels2;
5431  std::vector<PosInfo> locations, locations2;
5432 
5433  RB::SourcePositionPair sources;
5434 
5435  SgExpression* selector = nullptr;

5437 
5438  if (ATmatch(term, "CaseStatement(<term>,<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_labels, &t_formula, &t_case_body, &t_labels2)) {
5439  if (traverse_LabelList(t_labels, labels, locations)) {
5440  // MATCHED LabelList
5441  } else return ATfalse;
5442 
5443  if (traverse_Formula(t_formula, selector)) {
5444  // MATCHED Formula
5445  } else return ATfalse;
5446 
5447  // Begin SageTreeBuilder
5448  sage_tree_builder.Enter(switch_stmt, selector, sources);
5449  setSourcePosition(switch_stmt, term);
5450 
5451  if (traverse_CaseBody(t_case_body)) {
5452  // MATCHED CaseBody
5453  } else return ATfalse;
5454 
5455  if (traverse_LabelList(t_labels2, labels2, locations2)) {
5456  // MATCHED LabelList
5457  ROSE_ASSERT(locations2.size() == 0); // TODO
5458  } else return ATfalse;
5459  }
5460  else return ATfalse;
5461 
5462 // End SageTreeBuilder
5463  sage_tree_builder.Leave(switch_stmt);

5465  return ATtrue;

5615 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_CaseIndex(ATerm term, SgExpression* &case_index)

5619 #endif
5620 
5621  ATerm t_formula1, t_formula2;
5622  SgExpression* lower_bound = nullptr;
5623  SgExpression* upper_bound = nullptr;
5624 
5625  case_index = nullptr;
5626 
5627 // This case is needed to traverse CompileTimeFormula -> CaseIndex
5628  if (ATmatch(term, "CaseIndex(<term>)", &t_formula1)) {
5629  if (traverse_Formula(t_formula1, case_index)) {
5630  // MATCHED Formula
5631  } else return ATfalse;
5632  }
5633 
5634 // This case is needed to traverse LowerBound : UpperBound -> CaseIndex
5635  else if (ATmatch(term, "CaseIndex(<term>,<term>)", &t_formula1, &t_formula2)) {
5636  if (traverse_Formula(t_formula1, lower_bound)) {
5637  // MATCHED Formula
5638  } else return ATfalse;
5639  if (traverse_Formula(t_formula2, upper_bound)) {
5640  // MATCHED Formula
5641  } else return ATfalse;
5642 
5643  // Perhaps SgRangeExp should be used instead for the stride and then won't need to insert literal "1"
5644  SgExpression* stride = SB::buildIntVal_nfi(std::string("1"));
5645 
5646  case_index = SB::buildSubscriptExpression_nfi(lower_bound, upper_bound, stride);
5647  }
5648  else return ATfalse;
5649 
5650  if (case_index == nullptr) {
5651  mlog[WARN] << "UNIMPLEMENTED: CaseIndex = nullptr, probably StatusConstant in lower_bound or upper_bound\n";
5652  }
5653 
5654  ASSERT_not_null(case_index);
5655  setSourcePosition(case_index, term);
5656 
5657  return ATtrue;

6063 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_UnaryExpression(ATerm term, SgExpression* &expr)
6064 {
6065 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
6066  printf("... traverse_UnaryExpression: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
6067 #endif
6068 
6069  ATerm t_formula;
6070  SgExpression* formula = nullptr;
6071  LanguageTranslation::ExpressionKind op = LT::e_none;
6072 
6073  if (ATmatch(term, "UnaryPlus(<term>)", &t_formula)) op = LT::e_operator_unary_plus;
6074  else if (ATmatch(term, "UnaryMinus(<term>)", &t_formula)) op = LT::e_operator_unary_minus;
6075  else if (ATmatch(term, "NOT(<term>)", &t_formula)) op = LT::e_operator_unary_not;
6076  else return ATfalse;
6077 
6078  if (traverse_Formula(t_formula, formula)) {
6079  // MATCHED Formula
6080  } else return ATfalse;
6081 
6082  ASSERT_not_null(formula);
6083 
6084  switch (op) {
6085  case e_operator_unary_plus:
6086  expr = new SgUnaryAddOp(formula, nullptr);
6087  break;
6088  case e_operator_unary_minus:
6089  expr = SageBuilder::buildMinusOp_nfi(formula, SgUnaryOp::prefix);
6090  break;
6091  case e_operator_unary_not:
6092  expr = SageBuilder::buildNotOp(formula);
6093  break;
6094  default:
6095  mlog[ERROR] << "unknown unary operator in traverse_UnaryExpression() \n";
6096  ROSE_ABORT();
6097  }
6098 
6099  ASSERT_not_null(expr);
6100  setSourcePosition(expr, term);
6101 
6102  return ATtrue;
6103 }
6104 
6105 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_BinaryExpression(ATerm term, SgExpression* &expr)
6106 {
6107 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
6108  printf("... traverse_BinaryExpression: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
6109 #endif
6110 
6111  ATerm t_lhs, t_rhs, t_oper;
6112  LanguageTranslation::ExpressionKind op = LT::e_none;
6113  SgExpression* lhs = nullptr;
6114  SgExpression* rhs = nullptr;
6115 
6116  // Arithmetic operators
6117  if (ATmatch(term, "Plus(<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_add;
6118  else if (ATmatch(term, "Minus(<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_subtract;
6119  else if (ATmatch(term, "Mult(<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_multiply;
6120  else if (ATmatch(term, "Div(<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_divide;
6121  else if (ATmatch(term, "Power(<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_exponentiate;
6122 
6123  // Relational operators
6124  else if (ATmatch(term, "LT(<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_less_than;
6125  else if (ATmatch(term, "GT(<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_greater_than;
6126  else if (ATmatch(term, "LE(<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_less_or_equal;
6127  else if (ATmatch(term, "GE(<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_greater_or_equal;
6128  else if (ATmatch(term, "EQ(<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_equality;
6129  else if (ATmatch(term, "NE(<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_not_equal;
6130 
6131  // Logical operators
6132  else if (ATmatch(term, "AND(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_oper, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_and;
6133  else if (ATmatch(term, "OR(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_oper, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_or;
6134  else if (ATmatch(term, "XOR(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_oper, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_xor;
6135  else if (ATmatch(term, "EQV(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_oper, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_equiv;
6136 
6137  else if (ATmatch(term, "Mod(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_lhs, &t_oper, &t_rhs)) op = LT::e_operator_mod;
6138 
6139  else return ATfalse;
6140 
6141  if (traverse_Formula(t_lhs, lhs)) {
6142  // MATCHED lhs
6143  } else return ATfalse;
6144  if (traverse_Formula(t_rhs, rhs)) {
6145  // MATCHED rhs
6146  } else return ATfalse;
6147 
6148  ROSE_ASSERT(lhs && rhs);
6149 
6150  switch (op) {
6151  // Arithmetic operators
6152  case e_operator_add:
6153  expr = SB::buildAddOp_nfi(lhs, rhs);
6154  break;
6155  case e_operator_subtract:
6156  expr = SB::buildSubtractOp_nfi(lhs, rhs);
6157  break;
6158  case e_operator_multiply:
6159  expr = SB::buildMultiplyOp_nfi(lhs, rhs);
6160  break;
6161  case e_operator_divide:
6162  expr = SB::buildDivideOp_nfi(lhs, rhs);
6163  break;
6164  case e_operator_exponentiate:
6165  expr = SB::buildExponentiationOp_nfi(lhs, rhs);
6166  break;
6167 
6168  // Relational operators
6169  case e_operator_less_than:
6170  expr = SB::buildLessThanOp_nfi(lhs, rhs);
6171  break;
6172  case e_operator_greater_than:
6173  expr = SB::buildGreaterThanOp_nfi(lhs, rhs);
6174  break;
6175  case e_operator_less_or_equal:
6176  expr = SB::buildLessOrEqualOp_nfi(lhs, rhs);
6177  break;
6178  case e_operator_greater_or_equal:
6179  expr = SB::buildGreaterOrEqualOp_nfi(lhs, rhs);
6180  break;
6181  case e_operator_equality:
6182  expr = SB::buildEqualityOp_nfi(lhs, rhs);
6183  break;
6184  case e_operator_not_equal:
6185  expr = SB::buildNotEqualOp_nfi(lhs, rhs);
6186  break;
6187 
6188  // Logical operators
6189  case e_operator_and:
6190  expr = SB::buildBitAndOp_nfi(lhs, rhs);
6191  break;
6192  case e_operator_or:
6193  expr = SB::buildBitOrOp_nfi(lhs, rhs);
6194  break;
6195  case e_operator_xor:
6196  expr = SB::buildBitXorOp_nfi(lhs, rhs);
6197  break;
6198  case e_operator_equiv:
6199  expr = SB::buildBinaryExpression_nfi<SgBitEqvOp>(lhs, rhs);
6200  break;
6201 
6202  case e_operator_mod:
6203  expr = SB::buildModOp_nfi(lhs, rhs);
6204  break;
6205 
6206  default:
6207  mlog[ERROR] << "unknown binary operator in traverse_BinaryExpression() \n";
6208  ROSE_ABORT();
6209  }
6210 
6211  ASSERT_not_null(expr);
6212  setSourcePosition(expr, term);
6213 
6214  return ATtrue;
6215 }
6216

6490 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6491 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_PointerFormula(ATerm term, SgExpression* &expr)
6492 {
6493 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
6494  printf("... traverse_PointerFormula: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
6495 #endif
6496 
6497  ATerm t_literal, t_formula, t_conv_type;
6498 
6499  SgType* convType{nullptr};
6500  SgExpression* castFormula{nullptr};
6501 
6502  if (ATmatch(term, "PointerFormula(<term>)", &t_literal)) {
6503  if (traverse_PointerLiteral(t_literal, expr)) {
6504  // PointerLiteral -> PointerFormula
6505  // MATCHED PointerLiteral
6506  } else return ATfalse;
6507 
6508  } else if (ATmatch(term, "PointerFormulaParens(<term>)", &t_formula)) {
6509  // '(' PointerFormula ')' -> PointerFormula
6510  if (traverse_PointerFormula(t_formula, expr)) {
6511  // MATCHED PointerFormula
6512  } else return ATfalse;
6513 
6514  } else if (ATmatch(term, "PointerFormulaConversion(<term>,<term>)", &t_conv_type, &t_formula)) {
6515  if (traverse_PointerConversion(t_conv_type, convType)) {
6516  // MATCHED PointerConversion
6517  } else return ATfalse;
6518 
6519  if (traverse_Formula(t_formula, castFormula)) {
6520  // MATCHED Formula
6521  } else return ATfalse;
6522 
6523  if (convType == nullptr) {
6524  // PointerConversion isa PointerConversionP term, get type from the formula
6525  if (auto cast = isSgCastExp(castFormula)) {
6526  convType = cast->get_type();
6527  }
6528  else if (isSgJovialBitVal(castFormula)) {
6529  convType = SB::buildJovialBitType(/*size*/nullptr);
6530  }
6531  else {
6532  // Don't have the type, punt and use nullptr
6533  convType = SB::buildNullptrType();
6534  }
6535  }
6536  ASSERT_not_null(convType);
6537  ASSERT_not_null(castFormula);
6538 
6539  // cast_enum? default? ctype? static? dynamic?
6540  SgCastExp* castExpr = SB::buildCastExp(castFormula, convType, SgCastExp::e_default);
6541  ASSERT_not_null(castExpr);
6542  setSourcePosition(castExpr, term);
6543  expr = castExpr;
6544  } else return ATfalse;
6545 
6546  return ATtrue;
6547 }

6549 //========================================================================================
6550 // 6.1 VARIABLE AND BLOCK REFERENCES
6551 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6552 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_Variable(ATerm term, SgExpression* &var)
6553 {
6554 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
6555  printf("... traverse_Variable: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
6556 #endif
6557  char* name{nullptr};
6558 
6559  // Look for a variable (or could be a function call because of ambiguities)
6560  if (ATmatch(term, "<str>" , &name)) {
6561  SgSymbol* symbol = SI::lookupSymbolInParentScopes(name);
6562 
6563  var = nullptr;
6564 
6565  // First look for a reference expression (coming from LOC function argument, need not technically be a variable)
6566  if (isSgLabelSymbol(symbol)) {
6567  var = SageBuilder::buildLabelRefExp(isSgLabelSymbol(symbol));
6568  // TODO: need _nfi
6569  SI::setOneSourcePositionNull(var);
6570  }
6571  else if (isSgFunctionSymbol(symbol)) {
6572  var = SageBuilder::buildFunctionRefExp_nfi(isSgFunctionSymbol(symbol));
6573  }
6574 
6575  // Next look for a function call because functions need not be declared yet
6576  //
6577  else if (isSgFunctionSymbol(symbol)) {
6578  SgFunctionCallExp* funcCall{nullptr};
6579  sage_tree_builder.Enter(funcCall, std::string(name), nullptr);
6580  sage_tree_builder.Leave(funcCall);
6581  var = funcCall;
6582  }
6583  else if (isSgClassSymbol(symbol) || isSgTypedefSymbol(symbol) || isSgEnumSymbol(symbol)) {
6584  var = SageBuilder::buildTypeExpression(symbol->get_type());
6585  }
6586  else if (isSgVariableSymbol(symbol) || symbol == nullptr) {
6587  var = sage_tree_builder.buildVarRefExp_nfi(std::string(name));
6588  }
6589  else {
6590  // TODO: look for a define and replace with define/macro name
6591  }
6592  ASSERT_not_null(var);
6593  setSourcePosition(var, term);
6594 
6595  // Look for other possibilities
6596  //
6597  } else if (traverse_Dereference(term, var)) {
6598  // MATCHED Dereference -> ItemDereference -> Item -> NamedVariable
6599  } else if (traverse_TableDereference(term, var)) {
6600  // MATCHED TableDereference
6601  } else if (traverse_TableItem(term, var)) {
6602  // MATCHED TableItem
6603  } else if (traverse_BitFunctionVariable(term, var)) {
6604  // MATCHED BitFunctionVariable
6605  } else if (traverse_ByteFunctionVariable(term, var)) {
6606  // MATCHED ByteFunctionVariable
6607  } else if (traverse_RepFunctionVariable(term, var)) {
6608  // MATCHED RepFunctionVariable
6609  } else if (traverse_NumericMachineParameter(term, var)) {
6610  // MATCHED NumericMachineParameter
6611  }
6612  else return ATfalse;
6613 
6614  return ATtrue;
6615 }
6616

6627  if (traverse_Variable(t_var, var)) {

6635 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_VariableList(ATerm term, std::vector<SgExpression*> &vars)
6636 {
6637 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
6638  printf("... traverse_VariableList: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
6639 #endif
6640 
6641  ATerm t_labels;
6642  SgExpression* var;
6643 
6644 // The variables in the list are lvalues in an assignment statement
6645 //
6646  if (ATmatch(term, "VariableList(<term>)" , &t_labels)) {
6647  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_labels);
6648  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
6649  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
6650  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
6651 
6652  if (traverse_VariableLVal(head, var)) {
6653  vars.push_back(var);
6654  } else return ATfalse;
6655  }
6656 
6657  // Because of ambiguities in the grammar the lvalue member must be set here, it can't be
6658  // set in traverse_ByteFunctionVariable or traverse_BitFunctionVariable (perhaps in BitFunctionVariable)
6659  SgFunctionCallExp* func_call = isSgFunctionCallExp(var);
6660  if (func_call) {
6661  func_call->set_lvalue(true);
6662  }
6663  }
6664  else return ATfalse;
6665 
6666  return ATtrue;
6667 }
6668 
6669 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_TableItem(ATerm term, SgExpression* &var)
6670 {
6671 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
6672  printf("... traverse_TableItem: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
6673 #endif
6674 
6675  ATerm t_name, t_subscript, t_tblderef;
6676  char* name;
6677  std::vector<SgExpression*> subscript;
6678 
6679  SgVarRefExp* varRef{nullptr};
6680  SgExprListExp* arraySubscripts{nullptr};
6681  SgExpression* derefVar{nullptr};
6682 
6683  var = nullptr;
6684 
6685  if (ATmatch(term, "TableItem(<term>,<term>,<term>)" , &t_name, &t_subscript, &t_tblderef)) {
6686  // Shall have a name
6687  if (ATmatch(t_name, "<str>", &name)) {
6688  // MATCHED name
6689  } else return ATfalse;
6690 
6691  // May have a subscript(s)
6692  if (traverse_Subscript(t_subscript, subscript)) {
6693  if (subscript.size() > 0) {
6694  arraySubscripts = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp_nfi();
6695  setSourcePosition(arraySubscripts, t_subscript);
6696 
6697  for (SgExpression* expr : subscript) {
6698  arraySubscripts->get_expressions().push_back(expr);
6699  expr->set_parent(arraySubscripts);
6700  }
6701  }
6702  }
6703 
6704  // Grammar could be better designed (Dereference is a TableDereference here (may have changed?))
6705  if (traverse_TableDereference(t_tblderef, derefVar)) {
6706  // MATCHED TableDereference
6707  }
6708  else if (traverse_Dereference(t_tblderef, derefVar, false)) {
6709  // MATCHED Dereference
6710  }
6711  else return ATfalse;
6712  }
6713  else return ATfalse;
6714 
6715  // There may not be a symbol for the variable in this scope (name maybe from external CompoolModule)
6716  auto scope{SageBuilder::topScopeStack()};
6717  if (nullptr == SI::lookupVariableSymbolInParentScopes(name, scope)) {
6718  // Look for symbol in the scope of the dereferenced variable
6719  if (auto type = isSgPointerType(derefVar->get_type())) {
6720  if (auto baseType = isSgJovialTableType(type->get_base_type())) {
6721  if (auto decl = baseType->get_declaration()) {
6722  // Don't actually need the symbol here as the scope of the deref'd
6723  // variable will be used in the SB::buildVarRefExp() call below.
6724  scope = decl->get_scope();
6725  }
6726  }
6727  }
6728  }
6729 
6730  varRef = SageBuilder::buildVarRefExp(name, scope);
6731  ASSERT_not_null(varRef);
6732  setSourcePosition(varRef, t_name);
6733 
6734  if (isSgTypeUnknown(varRef->get_type())) {
6735  mlog[WARN] << "Type of a TableItem is unknown, may cause trouble downstream\n";
6736  }
6737 
6738  if (arraySubscripts) {
6739  var = SageBuilder::buildPntrArrRefExp_nfi(varRef, arraySubscripts);
6740  }
6741  else {
6742  var = varRef;
6743  }
6744 
6745  if (derefVar) {
6746  var = SageBuilder::buildAtOp_nfi(var, derefVar);
6747  }
6748  setSourcePosition(var, term);
6749 
6750  return ATtrue;
6751 }
6752 
6753 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_Subscript(ATerm term, std::vector<SgExpression*> & indexes)
6754 {
6755 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
6756  printf("... traverse_Subscript: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
6757 #endif
6758 
6759  ATerm t_index;
6760  SgExpression* index;
6761 
6762  if (ATmatch(term, "no-subscript")) {
6763  // MATCHED no-subscript
6764  } else if (ATmatch(term, "Subscript(<term>)" , &t_index)) {
6765  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_index);
6766  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
6767  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
6768  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
6769  if (traverse_Formula(head, index)) {
6770  // MATCHED Index
6771  indexes.push_back(index);
6772  } else return ATfalse;
6773  }
6774  } else return ATfalse;
6775 
6776  return ATtrue;
6777 }
6778 
6779 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_TableDereference(ATerm term, SgExpression* &tableArrayRef)
6780 {
6781 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
6782  printf("... traverse_TableDereference: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
6783 #endif
6784 
6785  ATerm t_deref, t_subscript, t_name_or_formula;
6786  char* name;
6787  std::vector<SgExpression*> subscript;
6788  SgExprListExp* subscripts{nullptr};
6789  SgExpression* deref{nullptr};
6790 
6791  tableArrayRef = nullptr;
6792 
6793  if (ATmatch(term, "no-table-dereference")) {
6794  // MATCHED no-table-dereference
6795  return ATtrue;
6796  }
6797  else if (ATmatch(term, "TableDereference(<term>,<term>)", &t_deref, &t_subscript)) {
6798  // There shall be a subscript
6799  if (traverse_Subscript(t_subscript, subscript)) {
6800  subscripts = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp_nfi();
6801  setSourcePosition(subscripts, t_subscript);
6802  for (SgExpression* expr : subscript) {
6803  subscripts->get_expressions().push_back(expr);
6804  expr->set_parent(subscripts);
6805  }
6806  } else return ATfalse;
6807 
6808  // Handle the dereferencing part
6809  if (ATmatch(t_deref, "Dereference(<term>)", &t_name_or_formula)) {
6810  // MATCHED Dereference
6811  if (traverse_PointerFormula(t_name_or_formula, deref)) {
6812  // MATCHED PointerFormula
6813  deref = SageBuilder::buildPointerDerefExp(deref);
6814  setSourcePosition(deref, t_name_or_formula);
6815  tableArrayRef = SageBuilder::buildPntrArrRefExp_nfi(deref, subscripts);
6816  }
6817  else if (ATmatch(t_name_or_formula, "<str>", &name)) {
6818  // The right-hand side of a dereference (SgAtOp) may be a function call
6819  if (auto funSymbol = SI::lookupFunctionSymbolInParentScopes(name, SB::topScopeStack())) {
6820  tableArrayRef = SageBuilder::buildFunctionCallExp(funSymbol, subscripts);
6821  }
6822  else {
6823  auto varRef = SageBuilder::buildVarRefExp(name, SB::topScopeStack());
6824  setSourcePosition(varRef, t_name_or_formula);
6825  deref = SageBuilder::buildPointerDerefExp(varRef);
6826  setSourcePosition(deref, t_name_or_formula);
6827  tableArrayRef = SageBuilder::buildPntrArrRefExp_nfi(deref, subscripts);
6828  }
6829  }
6830  else return ATfalse;
6831  }
6832  else {
6833  // Grammar has been changed (for GL-394), this path unlikely (not preferred in grammar)
6834  mlog[WARN] << "TableDereference with no Dereference to name, not attempting to recover\n";
6835  ROSE_ABORT();
6836  }
6837  } else return ATfalse;
6838 
6839  ASSERT_not_null(tableArrayRef);
6840  setSourcePosition(tableArrayRef, term);
6841 
6842  return ATtrue;
6843 }
6844 
6845 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_Dereference(ATerm term, SgExpression* &expr, bool build_ptr_ref)
6846 {
6847 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
6848  printf("... traverse_Dereference: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
6849 #endif
6850  ATerm t_deref;
6851  char* name{nullptr};
6852  SgExpression* formula{nullptr};
6853 
6854  expr = nullptr;
6855 
6856  if (ATmatch(term, "Dereference(<term>)", &t_deref)) {
6857  if (ATmatch(t_deref, "<str>", &name)) {
6858  // MATCHED PointerItemName
6859  formula = SB::buildVarRefExp(name, SB::topScopeStack());
6860  setSourcePosition(formula, term);
6861  } else if (traverse_Formula(t_deref, formula)) {
6862  // MATCHED PointerFormula through Formula
6863  } else return ATfalse;
6864  }
6865  else return ATfalse;
6866 
6867  ASSERT_not_null(formula);
6868 
6869  if (build_ptr_ref) {
6870  expr = SB::buildPointerDerefExp(formula);
6871  }
6872  else {
6873  expr = formula;
6874  }
6875 
6876  return ATtrue;
6877 }

6879 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_BitFunctionVariable(ATerm term, SgExpression* &func_call)
6880 {
6881 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
6882  printf("... traverse_BitFunctionVariable: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
6883 #endif
6884 
6885  ATerm t_bitvar, t_var, t_fbit, t_nbit, t_first_bit, t_length;
6886 
6887  SgExpression* variable = nullptr;
6888  SgExpression* first_bit = nullptr;
6889  SgExpression* length = nullptr;
6890  SgType* return_type = nullptr;
6891 
6892  func_call = nullptr;
6893 
6894  // Grammar (this is an lvalue call expression, I don't think it can be an rvalue (BitFunction)
6895  // 'BIT' '(' Variable ',' Fbit ',' Nbit ')' -> BitFunctionVariable {cons("BitFunctionVariable"), prefer}
6896  // 'BIT' '(' Formula ',' Fbit ',' Nbit ')' -> BitFunctionVariable {cons("BitFunctionVariable")}
6897  //
6898  if (ATmatch(term, "BitFunctionVariable(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_bitvar, &t_fbit, &t_nbit)) {
6899  // Is it possible generate a Variable now or is Formula enough (try running all tests to see)
6900  // Formula may cover all (but only looking at rvalue at moment)
6901  if (ATmatch(t_bitvar, "Variable(<term>)", &t_var)) {
6902  if (traverse_Variable(t_var, variable)) {
6903  // MATCHED Variable
6904  // MATCHED BitVariable? -> Variable
6905  } else return ATfalse;
6906  } else if (traverse_Formula(t_bitvar, variable)) {
6907  // BooleanFormula generalized to Formula // checkout language spec if generalized (probably)
6908  } else return ATfalse;
6909 
6910  if (ATmatch(t_fbit, "Fbit(<term>)", &t_first_bit)) {
6911  if (traverse_Formula(t_first_bit, first_bit)) {
6912  // MATCHED Formula
6913  } else return ATfalse;
6914  } else return ATfalse;
6915 
6916  if (ATmatch(t_nbit, "Nbit(<term>)", &t_length)) {
6917  if (traverse_Formula(t_length, length)) {
6918  // MATCHED Formula
6919  } else return ATfalse;
6920  } else return ATfalse;
6921  }
6922  else return ATfalse;
6923 
6924  ASSERT_not_null(first_bit);
6925  ASSERT_not_null(length);
6926 
6927  // build the parameter list
6928  SgExprListExp* params = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp_nfi();
6929  params->append_expression(variable);
6930  params->append_expression(first_bit);
6931  params->append_expression(length);
6932 
6933  // get the variable type
6934  SgVarRefExp* var_ref = isSgVarRefExp(variable);
6935  if (var_ref) {
6936  // The return type is the type of the variable
6937  SgVariableSymbol* var_symbol = var_ref->get_symbol();
6938  ASSERT_not_null(var_symbol);
6939  return_type = var_symbol->get_type();
6940  }
6941  else {
6942  // Note: _assume_ that the return type is an intrinsic bit type
6943  SgExpression* size = nullptr;
6944  return_type = SB::buildJovialBitType(size);
6945  }
6946  ASSERT_not_null(return_type);
6947 
6948  func_call = SB::buildFunctionCallExp("BIT", return_type, params, SB::topScopeStack());
6949  ASSERT_not_null(func_call);
6950  setSourcePosition(func_call, term);
6951 
6952  func_call->set_lvalue(true);
6953 
6954  return ATtrue;
6955 }
6956 
6957 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_ByteFunctionVariable(ATerm term, SgExpression* &func_call)
6958 {
6959 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
6960  printf("... traverse_ByteFunctionVariable: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
6961 #endif
6962 
6963  ATerm t_variable, t_var, t_fbyte, t_nbyte;
6964 
6965  SgExpression* variable = nullptr;
6966  SgExpression* first_byte = nullptr;
6967  SgExpression* length = nullptr;
6968  SgType* return_type = nullptr;
6969 
6970  func_call = nullptr;
6971 
6972  // Grammar (this may be an lvalue call expression! or an rvalue depending on ambiguous context)
6973  // 'BYTE' '(' Variable ','
6974  // Fbyte ',' Nbyte ')' -> ByteFunctionVariable {cons("ByteFunctionVariable"), prefer}
6975  // 'BYTE' '(' Formula ','
6976  // Fbyte ',' Nbyte ')' -> ByteFunctionVariable {cons("ByteFunctionVariable")}
6977 
6978 
6979  // Grammar (this may be an lvalue call expression! or an rvalue depending on ambiguous context)
6980  // 'BYTE' '(' CharacterFormula/Variable ',' FirstByte ',' Length ')' -> ByteFunctionVariable
6981  //
6982  if (ATmatch(term, "ByteFunctionVariable(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_variable, &t_fbyte, &t_nbyte)) {
6983  if (ATmatch(t_variable, "Variable(<term>)", &t_var)) {
6984  if (traverse_Variable(t_var, variable)) {
6985  // MATCHED Variable
6986  } else return ATfalse;
6987  } else if (traverse_Formula(t_variable, variable)) {
6988  // BooleanFormula generalized to Formula (grammar changed from what)
6989  // MATCHED Formula
6990  } else return ATfalse;
6991 
6992  if (traverse_Formula(t_fbyte, first_byte)) {
6993  // MATCHED Formula
6994  } else return ATfalse;
6995 
6996  if (traverse_Formula(t_nbyte, length)) {
6997  // MATCHED Formula
6998  } else return ATfalse;
6999  }
7000  else return ATfalse;
7001 
7002  ASSERT_not_null(variable);
7003  ASSERT_not_null(first_byte);
7004  ASSERT_not_null(length);
7005 
7006  // build the parameter list
7007  SgExprListExp* params = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp_nfi();
7008  params->append_expression(variable);
7009  params->append_expression(first_byte);
7010  params->append_expression(length);
7011 
7012  // Create the return type.
7013  SgVarRefExp* var_ref = isSgVarRefExp(variable);
7014 
7015  if (var_ref) {
7016  SgVariableSymbol* var_symbol = var_ref->get_symbol();
7017  ASSERT_not_null(var_symbol);
7018  return_type = var_symbol->get_type();
7019  }
7020  else {
7021  // Create the return type. The length expression for the return_type can't be shared
7022  // so we need to either make a new one (if isSgIntVal) or a copy (if isSgVarRefExp).
7023  //
7024  SgExpression* new_length = nullptr;
7025  if (isSgIntVal(length)) {
7026  SgIntVal* length_val = isSgIntVal(length);
7027  new_length = SageBuilder::buildIntVal(length_val->get_value());
7028  }
7029  else {
7030  new_length = isSgVarRefExp(SI::deepCopyNode(length));
7031  }
7032  ASSERT_not_null(new_length);
7033 
7034  return_type = SageBuilder::buildStringType(new_length);
7035  }
7036  ASSERT_not_null(return_type);
7037 
7038  func_call = SB::buildFunctionCallExp("BYTE", return_type, params, SB::topScopeStack());
7039  ASSERT_not_null(func_call);
7040  setSourcePosition(func_call, term);
7041 
7042  func_call->set_lvalue(true);
7043 
7044  return ATtrue;
7045 }
7046 
7047 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_RepFunctionVariable(ATerm term, SgExpression* &func_call)
7048 {
7049 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
7050  printf("... traverse_RepFunctionVariable: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
7051 #endif
7052 
7053  ATerm t_rep, t_name, t_subscript;
7054  char* name;
7055  std::vector<SgExpression*> subscript;
7056  SgExpression* var_ref = nullptr;
7057  bool has_subscript = false;
7058 
7059  func_call = nullptr;
7060 
7061  if (ATmatch(term, "RepFunctionVariable(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_rep, &t_name, &t_subscript)) {
7062  // MATCHED RepFunctionVariable with subscripts
7063  has_subscript = true;
7064  }
7065  else if (ATmatch(term, "RepFunctionVariable(<term>,<term>)", &t_rep, &t_name)) {
7066  // MATCHED RepFunctionVariable without subscripts
7067  }
7068  else return ATfalse;
7069 
7070  if (ATmatch(t_rep, "RepConversion()")) {
7071  // MATCHED "REP" grammar keyword
7072  } else return ATfalse;
7073 
7074  if (ATmatch(t_name, "<str>", &name)) {
7075  // MATCHED NamedVariable
7076  var_ref = SB::buildVarRefExp(name, SB::topScopeStack());
7077  setSourcePosition(var_ref, t_name);
7078  } else return ATfalse;
7079 
7080  if (has_subscript) {
7081  if (traverse_Subscript(t_subscript, subscript)) {
7082  SgExprListExp* array_subscripts = SB::buildExprListExp_nfi();
7083  setSourcePosition(array_subscripts, t_subscript);
7084  for (SgExpression* expr : subscript) {
7085  array_subscripts->get_expressions().push_back(expr);
7086  expr->set_parent(array_subscripts);
7087  }
7088  var_ref = SB::buildPntrArrRefExp_nfi(var_ref, array_subscripts);
7089  setSourcePosition(var_ref, term); // source position too broad because of 'REP'
7090  } else return ATfalse;
7091  }
7092  ASSERT_not_null(var_ref);
7093 
7094  // build the parameter list
7095  SgExprListExp* params = SB::buildExprListExp_nfi();
7096  params->append_expression(var_ref);
7097 
7098  // Create the return type. The language specifies the result is a bit string and
7099  // has an example assuming BITSINWORD is 16. Because WORD is mentioned it seems
7100  // that long is a good choice for a return type.
7101  SgType* result_type = SB::buildLongType();
7102  ASSERT_not_null(result_type);
7103 
7104  func_call = SB::buildFunctionCallExp("REP", result_type, params, SB::topScopeStack());
7105  ASSERT_not_null(func_call);
7106  setSourcePosition(func_call, term);
7107 
7108  func_call->set_lvalue(true);
7109 
7110  return ATtrue;
7111 }
7112 
7113 //========================================================================================
7114 // 6.2 NAMED CONSTANTS
7115 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7116 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_NamedConstant(ATerm term, SgExpression* &var)
7117 {
7118 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
7119  printf("... traverse_NamedConstant: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
7120 #endif
7121 
7122  char* letter;
7123  var = nullptr;
7124 
7125  if (ATmatch(term, "ControlLetter(<str>)" , &letter)) {
7126  SgVarRefExp* var_ref = nullptr;
7127  sage_tree_builder.Enter(var_ref, std::string(letter));
7128  sage_tree_builder.Leave(var_ref);
7129  ASSERT_not_null(var_ref);
7130 
7131  var = var_ref;
7132  }
7133  else return ATfalse;
7134 
7135  // ConstantItemName -> NamedConstant {prefer} %% ambiguous with ConstantTableName
7136  // ConstantTableName -> NamedConstant {cons("ConstantTableName")}
7137  // ConstantTableName Subscript -> NamedConstant {cons("NamedConstant")}
7138 
7139  ASSERT_not_null(var);
7140 
7141  return ATtrue;
7142 }

7144 //========================================================================================
7145 // 6.3 FUNCTION CALLS
7146 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7147 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_FunctionCall(ATerm term, SgExpression* &expr)
7148 {
7149 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
7150  printf("... traverse_FunctionCall: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
7151 #endif
7152 
7153  SgFunctionCallExp* func_call = nullptr;
7154 
7155 // UserDefinedFunctionCall is ambiguous with type conversions (casts) in Jovial,
7156 // so a SgExpression is returned rather than a SgFunctionCallExp.
7157  if (traverse_UserDefinedFunctionCall(term, expr)) {
7158  // MATCHED UserDefinedFunctionCall
7159  }
7160  else if (traverse_IntrinsicFunctionCall(term, func_call)) {
7161  expr = func_call;
7162  }
7163  else return ATfalse;
7164 
7165  // MachineSpecificFunctionCall -> FunctionCall
7166 
7167  ASSERT_not_null(expr);
7168  setSourcePosition(expr, term);
7169 
7170  return ATtrue;
7171 }
7172 
7173 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_UserDefinedFunctionCall(ATerm term, SgExpression* &expr)
7174 {
7175 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
7176  printf("... traverse_UserDefinedFunctionCall: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
7177 #endif
7178 
7179  ATerm t_name, t_param_list;
7180  std::string name;
7181  SgExprListExp* expr_list = nullptr;
7182 
7183  expr = nullptr;
7184 
7185  if (ATmatch(term, "UserDefinedFunctionCall(<term>,<term>)", &t_name, &t_param_list)) {
7186  if (traverse_Name(t_name, name)) {
7187  // MATCHED FunctionName
7188  } else return ATfalse;
7189 
7190  // The grammar (UserDefinedFunctionCall) treats this as a parameter list
7191  // but in general (because of ambiguities) it is just a general expression list
7192  expr_list = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp_nfi();
7193 
7194  if (traverse_ActualParameterList(t_param_list, expr_list)) {
7195  // MATCHED ActualParameterList
7196  } else return ATfalse;
7197  }
7198  else return ATfalse;
7199 
7200  // Several different options due to ambiguous grammar:
7201  // 1. Table reference argument of a function call not yet declared,
7202  // e.g. LOC(table_var(5))
7203  // 2. Function call
7204  // a. With a function symbol
7205  // b. Without a function symbol (must build nondefining declaration)
7206  // 3. Type conversion
7207  // a. General conversion (isSgTypedefSymbol)
7208  // b. StatusConversion (isSgEnumSymbol)
7209  // 4. Variable
7210  // a. Table reference
7211  // b. Table initialization replication operator
7212 
7213 // The symbol is used to disambiguate the design of the grammar.
7214 // For Jovial the symbol should be present, unfortuately this is not true for Fortran
7215 //
7216  SgSymbol* symbol = SI::lookupSymbolInParentScopes(name, SB::topScopeStack());
7217 
7218 // No symbol exists yet (perhaps a table variable declared later)
7219 //
7220  if (!symbol && sage_tree_builder.isInitializationContext()) {
7221  // This will add a var ref to forward_var_refs_
7222  SgVarRefExp* var_ref = sage_tree_builder.buildVarRefExp_nfi(name);
7223  expr = SB::buildPntrArrRefExp_nfi(var_ref, expr_list); // table/array reference
7224  }
7225 
7226 // Look for function call
7227 //
7228  else if (isSgFunctionSymbol(symbol) || symbol == nullptr) {
7229  SgFunctionCallExp* func_call = nullptr;
7230  sage_tree_builder.Enter(func_call, name, expr_list);
7231  sage_tree_builder.Leave(func_call);
7232  expr = func_call;
7233  }
7234 
7235 // Look for type conversion
7236 //
7237  else if (isSgTypedefSymbol(symbol)) {
7238  SgCastExp* cast_expr = nullptr;
7239 
7240  ROSE_ASSERT(expr_list->get_expressions().size() == 1);
7241  SgExpression* cast_operand = expr_list->get_expressions()[0];
7242  ASSERT_not_null(cast_operand);
7243 
7244  sage_tree_builder.Enter(cast_expr, name, cast_operand);
7245  sage_tree_builder.Leave(cast_expr);
7246  expr = cast_expr;
7247  }
7248 
7249 // Look for StatusConversion
7250 //
7251  else if (isSgEnumSymbol(symbol)) {
7252  SgCastExp* cast_expr = nullptr;
7253 
7254  ROSE_ASSERT(expr_list->get_expressions().size() == 1);
7255  SgExpression* cast_operand = expr_list->get_expressions()[0];
7256  ASSERT_not_null(cast_operand);
7257 
7258  sage_tree_builder.Enter(cast_expr, name, cast_operand);
7259  sage_tree_builder.Leave(cast_expr);
7260  expr = cast_expr;
7261  }
7262 
7263 // Look for table variable, table member, or table initialization replication operator
7264 //
7265  else if (isSgVariableSymbol(symbol)) {
7266  // First look for a table type
7267  SgJovialTableType* table_type = nullptr;
7268  SgInitializedName* init_name = nullptr;
7269  SgExprListExp* dim_info = nullptr;
7270  SgVariableSymbol* var_sym = isSgVariableSymbol(symbol);
7271 
7272  if (var_sym) init_name = isSgInitializedName(var_sym->get_declaration());
7273  if (init_name) {
7274  if (SgModifierType* mod_type = isSgModifierType(init_name->get_type())) {
7275  table_type = isSgJovialTableType(mod_type->get_base_type());
7276  } else {
7277  table_type = isSgJovialTableType(init_name->get_type());
7278  }
7279  }
7280  if (!table_type) {
7281  // Variable could be a member of a table
7282  SgVariableDeclaration* var_decl = nullptr;
7283  SgClassDefinition* class_def = nullptr;
7284  SgJovialTableStatement* table_decl = nullptr;
7285 
7286  if (init_name) var_decl = isSgVariableDeclaration(init_name->get_parent());
7287  if (var_decl) class_def = isSgClassDefinition(var_decl->get_parent());
7288  if (class_def) {
7289  table_decl = isSgJovialTableStatement(class_def->get_parent());
7290  // Make sure this isn't a Block in disguise
7291  // TODO: make node SgJovialBlockStatement (or SgJovialBlockType?)
7292  if (table_decl && (table_decl->get_class_type() == SgClassDeclaration::e_jovial_block)) {
7293  table_decl = nullptr; // This a block not a table so don't allow table_type==true
7294  }
7295  }
7296  if (table_decl) table_type = isSgJovialTableType(table_decl->get_type());
7297  }
7298 
7299  if (table_type) {
7300  dim_info = table_type->get_dim_info();
7301  // Make sure the rank of the table is same as # of params in "function call"
7302  if (dim_info && (dim_info->get_expressions().size() == expr_list->get_expressions().size())) {
7303  SgVarRefExp* var_ref = nullptr;
7304  sage_tree_builder.Enter(var_ref, name);
7305  sage_tree_builder.Leave(var_ref);
7306  expr = SB::buildPntrArrRefExp_nfi(var_ref, expr_list);
7307  }
7308  else {
7309  mlog[ERROR] << "UserDefinedFunctionCall - variable reference ambiguous "
7310  << "with table reference (and rank is incorrect) for " << name;
7311  ROSE_ABORT();
7312  }
7313  }
7314  else {
7315  // Since there is a variable and the type isn't a table, this must be
7316  // a replication operator (yes?).
7317  if (expr_list->get_expressions().size() != 1) {
7318  // It is not clear that a replication operator can't have expression size other than 1.
7319  mlog[ERROR] << "UserDefinedFunctionCall - variable reference ambiguous "
7320  << "with replication operator and # expressions != 1 for variable " << name;
7321  ROSE_ABORT();
7322  }
7323 
7324  SgReplicationOp* rep_op = nullptr;
7325  SgExpression* value = expr_list->get_expressions()[0];
7326  ASSERT_not_null(value);
7327 
7328  sage_tree_builder.Enter(rep_op, name, value);
7329  sage_tree_builder.Leave(rep_op);
7330  expr = rep_op;
7331  }
7332  }
7333  ASSERT_not_null(expr);
7334  setSourcePosition(expr, term);
7335 
7336  return ATtrue;
7337 }
7338

7340 {

7343 #endif

7345  func_call = nullptr;
7346 
7347  if (traverse_StatusInverseFunction(term, func_call)) {
7348  // MATCHED StatusInverseFunction
7349  }
7350  else if (traverse_LocFunction(term, func_call)) {
7351  // MATCHED LocFunction
7352  }
7353  else if (traverse_NextFunction(term, func_call)) {
7354  // MATCHED NextFunction
7355  }
7356  else if (traverse_ByteFunction(term, func_call)) {
7357  // MATCHED ByteFunction
7358  }
7359  else if (traverse_ShiftFunction(term, func_call)) {
7360  // MATCHED ShiftFunction
7361  }
7362  else if (traverse_AbsFunction(term, func_call)) {
7363  // MATCHED AbsFunction
7364  }
7365  else if (traverse_BitFunction(term, func_call)) {
7366  // MATCHED BitFunction
7367  }
7368  else if (traverse_SignFunction(term, func_call)) {

7371  else if (traverse_SizeFunction(term, func_call)) {

7379  }
7380  else if (traverse_NentFunction(term, func_call)) {

7389 //========================================================================================
7390 // 6.3.1 LOC FUNCTIONS
7391 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7392 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_LocFunction(ATerm term, SgFunctionCallExp* &funcCall)
7393 {
7394 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
7395  printf("... traverse_LocFunction: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
7396 #endif
7397 
7398  ATerm t_argument;
7399  char* name;
7400  std::string locArgStr{};
7401  SgExpression* locArgExpr{nullptr};
7402  SgType* returnType{nullptr};
7403 
7404  funcCall = nullptr;
7405 
7406  if (ATmatch(term, "LocFunction(<term>)", &t_argument)) {
7407  if (traverse_Name(t_argument, locArgStr)) {
7408  locArgExpr = SB::buildVarRefExp(locArgStr, SB::topScopeStack());
7409  ASSERT_not_null(locArgExpr);
7410  }
7411  else if (ATmatch(t_argument, "<str>" , &name)) {
7412  if (!SI::lookupSymbolInParentScopes(name)) {
7413  // No symbol but perhaps a label statement already exists
7414  auto labels = sage_tree_builder.getLabels();
7415  if (labels.find(name) != labels.end()) {
7416  // The SgStringVal will later need to be converted to SgLabelRefExp (when we have a symbol)
7417  auto stringVal = SB::buildStringVal_nfi(name);
7418  labelRefs_.insert(std::make_pair(name, stringVal));
7419  locArgExpr = stringVal;
7420  }
7421  // Or perhaps there is a label DEF/REF declaration statement
7422  else {
7423  auto kvp = labelDecls_.find(name);
7424  if (kvp != labelDecls_.end()) {
7425  // TODO: duplication somehow with above, simplify
7426  // The SgStringVal will later need to be converted to SgLabelRefExp (when we have a symbol)
7427  auto stringVal = SB::buildStringVal_nfi(name);
7428  labelRefs_.insert(std::make_pair(name, stringVal));
7429  locArgExpr = stringVal;
7430  }
7431  }
7432  }
7433  }
7434 
7435  // Check for more complicated arguments
7436  if (!locArgExpr) {
7437  if (traverse_Variable(t_argument, locArgExpr)) {
7438  // MATCHED NamedVariable -> Variable
7439  }
7440  else if (traverse_UserDefinedFunctionCall(t_argument, locArgExpr)) {
7441  // MATCHED UserDefinedFunctionCall for when LocFunction argument is a TableItem
7442  }
7443  else return ATfalse;
7444  }
7445  }
7446  else return ATfalse;
7447 
7448  ASSERT_not_null(locArgExpr);
7449 
7450  // build the parameter list
7451  SgExprListExp* params = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp_nfi();
7452  params->append_expression(locArgExpr);
7453 
7454  // If the LOC arg is just a string, the function type should be void*
7455  if (isSgStringVal(locArgExpr)) {
7456  returnType = SB::buildNullptrType();
7457  }
7458  else {
7459  returnType = locArgExpr->get_type();
7460  }
7461  ASSERT_not_null(returnType);
7462 
7463  funcCall = SB::buildFunctionCallExp("LOC", returnType, params, SB::topScopeStack());
7464  ASSERT_not_null(funcCall);
7465  setSourcePosition(funcCall, term);
7466 
7467  return ATtrue;
7468 }

7505 
7506  func_call = SB::buildFunctionCallExp("NEXT", return_type, params, SB::topScopeStack());

7521 
7522  ATerm t_formula, t_fbit, t_nbit, t_fbit_formula, t_length;
7523  SgExpression* bit_formula, * first_bit, * length;
7524  SgType* return_type;
7525 
7526  func_call = nullptr;
7527 
7528  if (ATmatch(term, "BitFunction(<term>, <term>,<term>)", &t_formula, &t_fbit, &t_nbit)) {
7529  bit_formula = nullptr;
7530  first_bit = nullptr;
7531  length = nullptr;
7532  return_type = nullptr;
7533 
7534  if (traverse_Formula(t_formula, bit_formula)) {
7535  // BooleanFormula generalized to Formula

7540  if (ATmatch(t_fbit, "Fbit(<term>)", &t_fbit_formula)) {
7541  if (traverse_Formula(t_fbit_formula, first_bit)) {

7544  } else return ATfalse;
7545 
7546  if (ATmatch(t_nbit, "Nbit(<term>)", &t_length)) {
7547  if (traverse_Formula(t_length, length)) {
7548  // MATCHED Formula
7549  } else return ATfalse;
7550  } else return ATfalse;
7551  }
7552  else return ATfalse;
7553 
7554  ROSE_ASSERT(bit_formula && first_bit && length && return_type);
7555 
7556  // build the parameter list
7557  SgExprListExp* params = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp_nfi();

7560  params->append_expression(length);

7562  func_call = SB::buildFunctionCallExp("BIT", return_type, params, SB::topScopeStack());
7563  ASSERT_not_null(func_call);
7564  setSourcePosition(func_call, term);
7565 
7566  return ATtrue;

7569 //========================================================================================
7570 // 6.3.4 BYTE FUNCTIONS
7571 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7572 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_ByteFunction(ATerm term, SgFunctionCallExp* &func_call)
7573 {
7574 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
7575  printf("... traverse_ByteFunction: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
7576 #endif
7577 
7578  ATerm t_formula, t_fbyte, t_nbyte;
7579  SgExpression * character_formula, * first_byte, * length;
7580 
7581  func_call = nullptr;
7582 
7583  // Grammar
7584  //
7585  // 'BYTE' '(' Formula
7586  // ',' Fbyte ',' Nbyte ')' -> ByteFunction {cons("ByteFunction")}
7587 #if 0
7588  // 'BYTE' '(' RepFunctionVariable
7589  // ',' Fbyte ',' Nbyte ')' -> ByteFunction {cons("ByteFunction"), prefer}
7590 #endif
7591 
7592  if (ATmatch(term, "ByteFunction(<term>, <term>,<term>)", &t_formula, &t_fbyte, &t_nbyte)) {
7593  if (traverse_Formula(t_formula, character_formula)) {
7594  // MATCHED Formula -> Will either be CharacterFormula or CharacterLiteral through Formula
7595  } else return ATfalse;
7596 
7597  if (traverse_Formula(t_fbyte, first_byte)) {
7598  // MATCHED Formula
7599  } else return ATfalse;
7600 
7601  if (traverse_Formula(t_nbyte, length)) {
7602  // MATCHED Formula
7603  } else return ATfalse;
7604  }
7605  else return ATfalse;
7606 
7607  // build the parameter list
7608  SgExprListExp* params = SageBuilder::buildExprListExp_nfi();
7609  params->append_expression(character_formula);
7610  params->append_expression(first_byte);
7611  params->append_expression(length);
7612 
7613  // Create the return type. The length expression for the return_type can't be shared
7614  // so we need to either make a new one (if isSgIntVal) or a copy otherwise.
7615  //
7616  SgExpression* new_length = nullptr;
7617  if (isSgIntVal(length)) {
7618  SgIntVal* length_val = isSgIntVal(length);
7619  new_length = SageBuilder::buildIntVal(length_val->get_value());
7620  }
7621  else {
7622  new_length = isSgExpression(SI::deepCopyNode(length));
7623  }
7624  ASSERT_not_null(new_length);
7625 
7626  SgType* return_type = SB::buildStringType(new_length);
7627 
7628  func_call = SB::buildFunctionCallExp("BYTE", return_type, params, SB::topScopeStack());
7629  ASSERT_not_null(func_call);
7630  setSourcePosition(func_call, term);
7631 
7632  return ATtrue;
7633 }
