7788 //========================================================================================
7789 // 6.3.9 BOUNDS FUNCTIONS
7790 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7791 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_BoundsFunction(ATerm term, SgFunctionCallExp* &func_call)
7792 {
7793 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
7794  printf("... traverse_BoundsFunction: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
7795 #endif
7796 
7797  ATerm t_which, t_table_arg, t_dim;
7798  std::string function_name, table_or_type_name;
7799  SgExpression* table_arg = nullptr;
7800  SgExpression* dim_number = nullptr;
7801 
7802  func_call = nullptr;
7803 
7804  if (ATmatch(term, "BoundsFunction(<term>,<term>,<term>)", &t_which, &t_table_arg, &t_dim)) {
7805  if (ATmatch(t_which, "LBOUND()")) {
7806  function_name = "LBOUND";
7807  }
7808  else if (ATmatch(t_which, "UBOUND()")) {
7809  function_name = "UBOUND";
7810  } else return ATfalse;
7811 
7812  if (traverse_Name(t_table_arg, table_or_type_name)) {
7813  // MATCHED TableName
7814  } else return ATfalse;
7815 
7816  if (traverse_Formula(t_dim, dim_number)) {
7817  // MATCHED Formula
7818  } else return ATfalse;
7819 
7820  } else return ATfalse;
7821 
7822  // Find symbol and table name or table type name
7823  SgSymbol* symbol = SI::lookupSymbolInParentScopes(table_or_type_name, SB::topScopeStack());
7824  if (!symbol) {
7825  // could be anonymous type with variable declaration not seen yet
7826  std::string anon_type_name = mangleAnonymousName(table_or_type_name);
7827  symbol = SI::lookupSymbolInParentScopes(anon_type_name, SB::topScopeStack());
7828  // Not done yet, this is not the correct path
7829  ROSE_ABORT();
7830  }
7831  ASSERT_not_null(symbol);
7832 
7833  SgType* type = symbol->get_type();
7834  SgModifierType* mod_type = isSgModifierType(type);
7835  if (mod_type) {
7836  // unpack modifier wrapper (used for CONSTANT, for example)
7837  type = mod_type->get_base_type();
7838  }
7839 
7840  SgJovialTableType* table_type = isSgJovialTableType(type);
7841  ASSERT_not_null(table_type);
7842 
7843  switch (symbol->variantT())
7844  {
7845  case V_SgClassSymbol:
7846  {
7847  table_arg = SB::buildTypeExpression(table_type);
7848  break;
7849  }
7850  case V_SgVariableSymbol:
7851  {
7852  table_arg = SB::buildVarRefExp_nfi(isSgVariableSymbol(symbol));
7853  break;
7854  }
7855  default: ROSE_ABORT();
7856  }
7857 
7858  ASSERT_not_null(dim_number);
7859  ASSERT_not_null(table_arg);
7860  setSourcePosition(table_arg, t_table_arg);
7861 
7862  // build the parameter list
7863  SgExprListExp* params = SB::buildExprListExp_nfi();
7864  params->append_expression(table_arg);
7865  params->append_expression(dim_number);
7866 
7867 //TODO: Return type may be a status type depending on the declaration of the table
7868  SgType* return_type = SB::buildSignedIntType();
7869 
7870  func_call = SB::buildFunctionCallExp(function_name, return_type, params, SB::topScopeStack());
7871  ASSERT_not_null(func_call);
7872  setSourcePosition(func_call, term);
7873 
7874  return ATtrue;
7875 }

7878 // 6.3.10 NWDSEN FUNCTIONS
7879 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7880 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_NwdsenFunction(ATerm term, SgFunctionCallExp* &func_call)
7881 {
7882 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
7883  printf("... traverse_NwdsenFunction: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
7884 #endif
7885 
7886  ATerm t_argument;
7887  std::string name;
7888  SgExpression* table_arg = nullptr;
7889 
7890  func_call = nullptr;
7891 
7892  if (ATmatch(term, "NwdsenFunction(<term>)", &t_argument)) {
7893  if (traverse_Name(t_argument, name)) {
7894  // MATCHED TableName or TableTypeName
7895  } else return ATfalse;
7896  } else return ATfalse;
7897 
7898  // Find symbol and jovial table type
7899  SgSymbol* symbol = SI::lookupSymbolInParentScopes(name, SB::topScopeStack());
7900  ASSERT_not_null(symbol);
7901 
7902  SgJovialTableType* table_type = isSgJovialTableType(symbol->get_type());
7903  if (table_type == nullptr) {
7904  if (SgModifierType* mod_type = isSgModifierType(symbol->get_type())) {
7905  table_type = isSgJovialTableType(mod_type->get_base_type());
7906  }
7907  }
7908  ASSERT_not_null(table_type);
7909 
7910  switch (symbol->variantT())
7911  {
7912  case V_SgClassSymbol:
7913  {
7914  table_arg = SB::buildTypeExpression(table_type);
7915  break;
7916  }
7917  case V_SgVariableSymbol:
7918  {
7919  table_arg = SB::buildVarRefExp_nfi(isSgVariableSymbol(symbol));
7920  break;
7921  }
7922  default: ROSE_ABORT();
7923  }
7924 
7925  ASSERT_not_null(table_arg);
7926  setSourcePosition(table_arg, t_argument);
7927 
7928  // build the parameter list
7929  SgExprListExp* params = SB::buildExprListExp_nfi();
7930  params->append_expression(table_arg);
7931 
7932  SgType* return_type = SB::buildSignedIntType();
7933 
7934  func_call = SB::buildFunctionCallExp("NWDSEN", return_type, params, SB::topScopeStack());
7935  ASSERT_not_null(func_call);
7936  setSourcePosition(func_call, term);
7937 
7938  return ATtrue;
7939 }

7944 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_StatusInverseFunction(ATerm term, SgFunctionCallExp* &func_call)
7945 {
7946 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
7947  printf("... traverse_StatusInverseFunction: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
7948 #endif
7949 
7950  ATerm t_argument;
7951  SgExpression* argument;
7952  std::string function_name;
7953  std::string var_name;
7954  SgExpression* param = nullptr;
7955 
7956  func_call = nullptr;
7957 
7958  if (ATmatch(term, "StatusInverseFunctionFIRST(<term>)", &t_argument)) {
7959  if (traverse_Formula(t_argument, argument)) {
7960  // MATCHED StatusFormula
7961  }
7962  else if (traverse_Name(t_argument, var_name)) {
7963  // MATCHED StatusTypeName
7964  }
7965  else return ATfalse;
7966  function_name = "FIRST";
7967  }
7968  else if (ATmatch(term, "StatusInverseFunctionLAST(<term>)", &t_argument)) {
7969  if (traverse_Formula(t_argument, argument)) {
7970  // MATCHED StatusFormula
7971  }
7972  else if (traverse_Name(t_argument, var_name)) {
7973  // MATCHED StatusTypeName
7974  }
7975  else return ATfalse;
7976  function_name = "LAST";
7977  }
7978  else return ATfalse;
7979 
7980 // Build the parameter list and then the variable reference or type expression
7981  SgExprListExp* params = SB::buildExprListExp_nfi();
7982 
7983 // The variable may be a status type
7984  SgSymbol* symbol = SI::lookupSymbolInParentScopes(var_name, SB::topScopeStack());
7985  if (symbol) {
7986  SgEnumType* type = isSgEnumType(symbol->get_type());
7987  if (type) {
7988  param = SB::buildTypeExpression(type);
7989  }
7990  }
7991  if (!param) {
7992  // Parameter is not a type expression so it must be a variable
7993  param = SB::buildVarRefExp(var_name, SB::topScopeStack());
7994  }
7995  ASSERT_not_null(param);
7996  params->append_expression(param);
7997 
7998  SgType* return_type = SB::buildIntType();
7999 
8000  func_call = SB::buildFunctionCallExp(function_name, return_type, params, SB::topScopeStack());
8001 
8002  ASSERT_not_null(func_call);
8003 
8004  return ATtrue;
8005 }

8253 //========================================================================================
8254 // 8.3.1 NUMERIC LITERAL
8255 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8256 
8257 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_FixedOrFloatingLiteral(ATerm term, SgExpression* &expr)
8258 {
8259 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
8260  printf("... traverse_FixedOrFloatingLiteral: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
8261 #endif
8262 
8263  ATerm t_frac_form, t_num1, t_num2, t_opt_exp;
8264  std::string literal, opt_exp;
8265  char* number;
8266 
8267  expr = nullptr;
8268 
8269 // FractionalForm OptExponent -> RealLiteral
8270  if (ATmatch(term, "RealLiteralFF(<term>,<term>)", &t_frac_form, &t_opt_exp)) {
8271 
8272  if (ATmatch(t_frac_form, "FractionalForm(<term>,<term>)", &t_num1, &t_num2)) {
8273 
8274  // NOTE: reconstruct the integer, ".", fractional part, exponent into one string
8275 
8276  // integer part
8277  if (ATmatch(t_num1, "no-number()")) {
8278  // no integer part
8279  }
8280  else if (ATmatch(t_num1, "<str>", &number)) {
8281  literal += number;
8282  }
8283  else return ATfalse;
8284 
8285  // fractional part
8286  if (ATmatch(t_num2, "no-number()")) {
8287  // no fractional part
8288  literal += ".";
8289  }
8290  else if (ATmatch(t_num2, "<str>", &number)) {
8291  literal += ".";
8292  literal += number;
8293  }
8294  else return ATfalse;
8295 
8296  // optional exponent
8297  if (ATmatch(t_opt_exp, "no-exponent()")) {
8298  // no exponent
8299  }
8300 
8301  else if (traverse_Exponent(t_opt_exp, opt_exp)) {
8302  literal += opt_exp;
8303  }
8304 
8305  }
8306  }
8307  else if (ATmatch(term, "RealLiteralIE(<term>,<term>)", &t_num1, &t_opt_exp)) {
8308  if (ATmatch(t_num1, "<str>", &number)) {
8309  literal += number;
8310  } else return ATfalse;
8311 
8312  if (traverse_Exponent(t_opt_exp, opt_exp)) {
8313  literal += opt_exp;
8314  } else return ATfalse;
8315  }
8316  else return ATfalse;
8317 
8318  if (literal == "." || literal.size() < 1) {
8319  mlog[WARN] << "ERROR in traverse_FixedOrFloatingLiteral, no float literal, contains only: " << literal << "\n";;
8320  ROSE_ABORT();
8321  }
8322 
8323  expr = SageBuilder::buildFloatVal_nfi(literal);
8324  setSourcePosition(expr, term);
8325 
8326  return ATtrue;
8327 }
8328 
8329 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_Exponent(ATerm term, std::string & opt_exp)
8330 {
8331 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
8332  printf("... traverse_Exponent: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
8333 #endif
8334 
8335  ATerm t_sign, t_num;
8336  char* number;
8337 
8338 
8339  if (ATmatch(term, "Exponent(<term>,<term>)", &t_sign, &t_num)) {
8340  LanguageTranslation::ExpressionKind op_enum;
8341  if (traverse_OptSign(t_sign, op_enum)) {
8342  // MATCHED OptSign
8343  } else return ATfalse;
8344 
8345  if (op_enum == LanguageTranslation::e_operator_unary_minus) {
8346  opt_exp += "E";
8347  opt_exp += "-";
8348  }
8349  else if (op_enum == LanguageTranslation::e_operator_unary_plus) {
8350  opt_exp += "E";
8351  opt_exp += "+";
8352  }
8353  else if (op_enum == LanguageTranslation::e_operator_unity) {
8354  opt_exp += "E";
8355  }
8356 
8357  if (ATmatch(t_num, "<str>", &number)) {
8358  opt_exp += number;
8359  } else return ATfalse;
8360  }
8361 
8362  else return ATfalse;
8363 
8364  return ATtrue;
8365 }

8367 //========================================================================================
8368 // 8.3.2 BIT LITERAL
8369 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8370 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_BitLiteral(ATerm term, SgExpression* &expr)
8371 {
8372 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
8373  printf("... traverse_BitLiteral: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
8374 #endif
8375 
8376  // BeadSize 'B' "'" Bead+ "'" -> BitLiteral {cons("BitLiteral")}
8377 
8378  // from JovialLex.sdf
8379  // [1-5] -> BeadSize
8380  // [A-V] -> Bead
8381 
8382  ATerm t_bead_size, t_bead;
8383  char * bead_size, *bead;
8384  std::string literal = "";
8385 
8386  expr = nullptr;
8387 
8388  if (ATmatch(term, "BitLiteral(<term>,<term>)", &t_bead_size, &t_bead)) {
8389  if (ATmatch(t_bead_size, "<str>", &bead_size)) {
8390  // MATCHED BeadSize
8391  literal += bead_size;
8392  } else return ATfalse;
8393 
8394  literal += "B'";
8395 
8396  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_bead);
8397  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
8398  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
8399  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
8400  if (ATmatch(head, "<str>", &bead)) {
8401  // MATCHED Bead
8402  literal += bead;
8403  } else return ATfalse;
8404  }
8405 
8406  literal += "'";
8407 
8408  expr = SageBuilder::buildJovialBitVal_nfi(literal);
8409  setSourcePosition(expr, term);
8410  } else return ATfalse;
8411 
8412  ASSERT_not_null(expr);
8413 
8414  return ATtrue;
8415 }

8456 //========================================================================================
8457 // 9.0 DIRECTIVES
8458 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8459 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_DirectiveList(ATerm term)
8460 {
8461 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
8462  printf("... traverse_DirectiveList: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
8463 #endif
8464 
8465  if (ATmatch(term, "[]")) {
8466  // Matched an empty list
8467  return ATtrue;
8468  }
8469 
8470 // At this point there must be a non-empty list to succeed
8471 //
8472  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", term);
8473  if (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
8474  // found a non-empty list
8475  } else return ATfalse;
8476 
8477  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
8478  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
8479  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
8480  if (traverse_Directive(head)) {
8481  // MATCHED Directive
8482  } else return ATfalse;
8483  }

8551 //========================================================================================
8552 // 9.1 COMPOOL DIRECTIVES
8553 //----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8554 ATbool ATermToSageJovialTraversal::traverse_CompoolDirective(ATerm term)
8555 {
8556 #if PRINT_ATERM_TRAVERSAL
8557  printf("... traverse_CompoolDirective: %s\n", ATwriteToString(term));
8558 #endif
8559 
8560  ATerm t_dir_list, t_compool_name, t_decl_name;
8561  std::string declared_name;
8562  std::string compool_name;
8563  std::vector<std::string> declared_name_list;
8564  SgJovialDirectiveStatement* directive_stmt = nullptr;
8565 
8566  if (ATmatch(term, "CompoolDirective(<term>)", &t_dir_list)) {
8567 
8568  if (ATmatch(t_dir_list, "CompoolDirectiveList(<term>)", &t_compool_name)) {
8569  if (ATmatch(t_compool_name, "no-compool-file-name")) {
8570  // MATCHED no-compool-file-name
8571  }
8572  else if (traverse_CharacterLiteral(t_compool_name, compool_name)) {
8573  // '(' OptCompoolFileName ')' -> CompoolDirectiveList {cons("CompoolDirectiveList")}
8574  } else return ATfalse;
8575  }
8576  else if (ATmatch(t_dir_list, "CompoolDirectiveList(<term>, <term>)", &t_compool_name, &t_decl_name)) {
8577  if (ATmatch(t_compool_name, "no-compool-file-name")) {
8578  // MATCHED no-compool-file-name
8579  }
8580  else if (traverse_CharacterLiteral(t_compool_name, compool_name)) {
8581  // '(' OptCompoolFileName ')' -> CompoolDirectiveList {cons("CompoolDirectiveList")}
8582  } else return ATfalse;
8583 
8584  ATermList tail = (ATermList) ATmake("<term>", t_decl_name);
8585  while (! ATisEmpty(tail)) {
8586  ATerm head = ATgetFirst(tail);
8587  tail = ATgetNext(tail);
8588  if (traverse_Name(head, declared_name)) {
8589  // CompoolDeclaredName is a list of names to be used by the current module
8590  std::string lc_name{declared_name};
8591  // Convert to lower case to enable case insensitivity
8592  std::transform(declared_name.begin(), declared_name.end(), lc_name.begin(), ::tolower);
8593  declared_name_list.push_back(std::string(lc_name));
8594  mlog[DEBUG] << "appended declared compool name: " << lc_name << " compool " << compool_name <<"\n";
8595  } else return ATfalse;
8596  }
8597  } else return ATfalse;
8598  }
8599  else return ATfalse;
8600 
8601 // Remove single quotes
8602  unsigned int len = compool_name.length();
8603  ROSE_ASSERT(len > 2);
8604  if (compool_name[0] == '\'' && compool_name[len-1] == '\'') {
8605  compool_name = compool_name.substr(1,len-2);
8606  }
8607 
8608  sage_tree_builder.Enter(directive_stmt, compool_name, declared_name_list);
8609  directive_stmt->set_directive_type(SgJovialDirectiveStatement::e_compool);
8610 
8611  sage_tree_builder.Leave(directive_stmt);
8612 
8613  return ATtrue;
8614 }

8991 SgFunctionCallExp* ATermSupport::
8992 buildIntrinsicFunctionCallExp_nfi(const std::string &name, SgExprListExp* params, SgScopeStatement* scope)
8993 {
8994  SgType* type = nullptr;
8995  SgFunctionCallExp* callExpr = nullptr;
8996 
8997  if (!params) {
8998  params = SB::buildExprListExp_nfi();
8999  }
9000  if (!scope) {
9001  scope = SB::topScopeStack();
9002  }
9003  ASSERT_not_null(params);
9004  ASSERT_not_null(scope);
9005 
9006  // Create a return type based on the intrinsic name
9007  if (name == "BYTEPOS") {
9008  type = SageBuilder::buildIntType();
9009  }
9010  else if (name == "IMPLINTSIZE") {
9011  type = SageBuilder::buildIntType();
9012  }
9013  else if (name == "MAXINT") {
9014  type = SageBuilder::buildIntType();
9015  }
9016  else if (name == "MINFRACTION") {
9017  type = SageBuilder::buildIntType();
9018  }
9019  else if (name == "MININT") {
9020  type = SageBuilder::buildIntType();
9021  }
9022  else if (name == "MINRELPRECISION") {
9023  type = SageBuilder::buildIntType();
9024  }
9025  else if (name == "MINSCALE") {
9026  type = SageBuilder::buildIntType();
9027  }
9028  else if (name == "MINSIZE") {
9029  type = SageBuilder::buildIntType();
9030  }
9031 
9032  // Create double return type (Note: assumes double for max float)
9033  else if (name == "FLOATRELPRECISION") {
9034  type = SageBuilder::buildDoubleType();
9035  }
9036  else if (name == "FLOATUNDERFLOW") {
9037  type = SageBuilder::buildDoubleType();
9038  }
9039 
9040  else {
9041  type = SB::buildVoidType();
9042  }
9043 
9044  if (type) {
9045  callExpr = SB::buildFunctionCallExp(SgName(name), type, params, scope);
9046  ASSERT_not_null(callExpr);
9047  SI::setSourcePosition(callExpr);
9048  }
9049 
9050  return callExpr;
9051 }
